    if (replacement.outline == OutlineMode::Explicit)
        replacement.outline = OutlineMode::None;

    return setMesh(id, meshIndex, replacement);
}

bool Scene::setVertexPosition(EntityId id, std::size_t meshIndex, std::size_t vertexIndex, const glm::vec3& position) {
    const auto* mesh = getMesh(id, meshIndex);

    if (!mesh || vertexIndex >= mesh->localVertices.size() || !detail::finiteVector(position))
        return Diagnostics::failAt(
            __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Scene, "Scene::setVertexPosition",
            "Rejected condition: !mesh||vertexIndex>=mesh->localVertices.size()||!detail::finiteVector(position)",
            "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships.", id);

    auto replacement = *mesh;

    replacement.localVertices[vertexIndex] = position;
    recalculateNormals(replacement);

    return setMesh(id, meshIndex, replacement);
}

bool Scene::setTriangleIndices(EntityId id, std::size_t meshIndex, const std::vector<std::uint32_t>& indices) {
    const auto* mesh = getMesh(id, meshIndex);

    if (!mesh)
        return Diagnostics::failAt(
            __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Scene, "Scene::setTriangleIndices", "Rejected condition: !mesh",
            "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships.", id);

    auto replacement = *mesh;

    replacement.shape = GLFace::Mesh;
    replacement.triangleIndices = indices;

    if (!detail::validMesh(replacement))
        return Diagnostics::failAt(
            __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Scene, "Scene::setTriangleIndices",
            "Rejected condition: !detail::validMesh(replacement)",
            "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships.", id);
    recalculateNormals(replacement);

    return setMesh(id, meshIndex, replacement);
}

bool Scene::generateTexcoords(EntityId id, std::size_t meshIndex, const UVOptions& options) {
    const auto* mesh = getMesh(id, meshIndex);

    if (!mesh)
        return Diagnostics::failAt(
            __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Scene, "Scene::generateTexcoords", "Rejected condition: !mesh",
            "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships.", id);

    auto replacement = *mesh;

    return graphics::generateTexcoords(replacement, options) && setMesh(id, meshIndex, replacement);
}

bool Scene::transformTexcoords(EntityId id, std::size_t meshIndex, const glm::vec2& scale, const glm::vec2& offset,
                               float rotationDegrees) {
    const auto* mesh = getMesh(id, meshIndex);

    if (!mesh)
        return Diagnostics::failAt(
            __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Scene, "Scene::transformTexcoords", "Rejected condition: !mesh",
            "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships.", id);

    auto replacement = *mesh;

    return graphics::transformTexcoords(replacement, scale, offset, rotationDegrees) &&
           setMesh(id, meshIndex, replacement);
}

bool Scene::setTexcoords(EntityId id, std::size_t meshIndex, const std::vector<glm::vec2>& uvs) {
    const auto* mesh = getMesh(id, meshIndex);

    if (!mesh)
        return Diagnostics::failAt(
            __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Scene, "Scene::setTexcoords", "Rejected condition: !mesh",
            "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships.", id);

    auto replacement = *mesh;

    replacement.texcoords = uvs;

    return setMesh(id, meshIndex, replacement);
}

bool Scene::setVertexNormals(EntityId id, std::size_t meshIndex, const std::vector<glm::vec3>& normals) {
    const auto* mesh = getMesh(id, meshIndex);

    if (!mesh)
        return Diagnostics::failAt(
            __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Scene, "Scene::setVertexNormals", "Rejected condition: !mesh",
            "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships.", id);

    auto replacement = *mesh;

    replacement.vertexNormals = normals;

    return setMesh(id, meshIndex, replacement);
}

bool Scene::setMaterial(EntityId id, std::size_t meshIndex, const Material& material) {
    const auto* mesh = getMesh(id, meshIndex);

    if (!mesh)
        return Diagnostics::failAt(
            __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Scene, "Scene::setMaterial", "Rejected condition: !mesh",
            "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships.", id);

    auto replacement = *mesh;

    replacement.material = material;

    return setMesh(id, meshIndex, replacement);
}

bool Scene::setOutline(EntityId id, std::size_t meshIndex, OutlineMode mode,
                       const std::vector<std::uint32_t>& explicitEdges) {
    const auto* mesh = getMesh(id, meshIndex);

    if (!mesh)
        return Diagnostics::failAt(
            __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Scene, "Scene::setOutline", "Rejected condition: !mesh",
            "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships.", id);

    auto replacement = *mesh;

    replacement.outline = mode;
    replacement.outlineIndices = explicitEdges;

    return setMesh(id, meshIndex, replacement);
}

bool Scene::setLocalBasis(EntityId id, PivotMode mode, const glm::vec3& customPivot) {
    if (id >= components_.size() || !detail::finiteVector(customPivot))
        return Diagnostics::failAt(
            __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Scene, "Scene::setLocalBasis",
            "Rejected condition: id>=components_.size()||!detail::finiteVector(customPivot)",
            "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships.", id);

    auto& c = components_[id];

    if (c.transformOnly && mode == PivotMode::BottomCenter)
        return Diagnostics::failAt(
            __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Scene, "Scene::setLocalBasis",
            "Rejected condition: c.transformOnly && mode==PivotMode::BottomCenter",
            "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships.", id);

    if (mode == PivotMode::BottomCenter)
        c.transform.localBasis = detail::bottomCenter(c.polyhedron);
    else if (mode == PivotMode::Custom)
        c.transform.localBasis = customPivot;
    c.pivotMode = mode;

    return true;
}

bool Scene::setVisible(EntityId id, bool visible) {
    if (id >= components_.size())
        return Diagnostics::failAt(
            __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Scene, "Scene::setVisible", "Rejected condition: id>=components_.size()",
            "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships.", id);
    components_[id].visible = visible;

    return true;
}

bool Scene::splitFace(EntityId id, std::size_t faceIndex) {
    if (!getMesh(id, faceIndex))
        return Diagnostics::failAt(
            __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Scene, "Scene::splitFace", "Rejected condition: !getMesh(id,faceIndex)",
            "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships.", id);
    // The same face remains under its parent; vertices and indices are already face-local storage.
    auto& face = components_[id].polyhedron.faces[faceIndex];

    if (!face.independence) {
        face.transform = Transform3D{};
        face.independence = true;
    }

    return true;
}

bool Scene::setFaceSRT(EntityId id, std::size_t faceIndex, const Transform3D& transform) {
    return setFaceTransform(id, faceIndex, transform, true);
}
} // namespace graphics

카메라와 직접 Renderer 사용

Application 대신 자체 창을 소유하는 호스트가 Scene을 직접 그리는 상황이다. 아래 함수는 이미 OpenGL 3.3 컨텍스트가 현재인 동안만 호출한다. 일반 실습에서는 Application::renderScene/renderViews가 이 책임을 맡는다.

변수·객체 역할. camera.position은 시점, target은 바라보는 점, near/far는 보이는 깊이 범위다. RenderPass는 카메라·픽셀 사각형·옵션·clear 정책을 한 번의 드로우 묶음으로 전달한다.

새로 작성한 사용 사례 · 단편별 전제는 본문 참조 · 빌드하지 않음

bool renderInCurrentContext(const graphics::Scene& scene,int width,int height) {
    graphics::Camera camera; camera.position={4,3,6};
    if(!graphics::CameraSystem::validCamera(camera)||width<1||height<1) return false;
    auto view=graphics::CameraSystem::viewMatrix(camera);
    auto projection=graphics::CameraSystem::projectionMatrix(camera,float(width)/height);
    (void)view;(void)projection;
    graphics::Renderer renderer;
    if(!renderer.initialize()) return false;
    graphics::RenderOptions options; options.depthTest=true;
    bool ok=renderer.render(scene,camera,width,height,options);
    graphics::RenderPass pass; pass.camera=camera;pass.viewport={0,0,width,height};
    ok=renderer.renderPass(scene,pass,width,height)&&ok;
    ok=renderer.renderViews(scene,{pass},width,height)&&ok;
    renderer.destroy(); // 현재 컨텍스트가 유효한 정상 종료 경로
    return ok;
}
void onContextLost(graphics::Renderer& renderer) {
    renderer.abandon(); // GL 호출이 불가능한 별도 실패 경로: GPU delete를 호출하지 않는다.
}
// Renderer 복사 생성/대입은 =delete. 동일 GPU 핸들을 두 객체가 소유할 수 없다.

세 렌더 호출은 API별 사용 예를 순서대로 보여준다. 실제 한 프레임에서는 의도한 방식 하나를 선택한다. destroy와 abandon은 같은 종료 지점에서 연속 호출하는 API가 아니다.

실제 저장소 소스 · framework/detail/Renderer.cpp
#include "../Framework.h"
#include "Internal.h"
#include "Shaders.h"
#include "../dependencies/glm/glm/gtc/type_ptr.hpp"
#include <algorithm>
#include <fstream>
#include <iostream>
#include <sstream>
#include <cstring>

namespace graphics {
std::string readTextFile(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
    std::ifstream input(path, std::ios::binary);

    if (!input)
        return {};

    std::ostringstream buffer;

    buffer << input.rdbuf();

    auto text = buffer.str();

    if (text.compare(0, 3, "\xEF\xBB\xBF") == 0)
        text.erase(0, 3);

    return text;
}

namespace detail {
GLuint compileShader(GLenum kind, const std::string& sourceText, const std::filesystem::path& sourcePath) {
    Diagnostics::trace(PipelineStage::Shader, "compileShader");

    auto& api = gl();
    const auto shader = api.CreateShader(kind);

    if (!shader) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Shader, "glCreateShader", "Shader allocation failed.");

        return 0;
    }

    const char* text = sourceText.c_str();

    api.ShaderSource(shader, 1, &text, nullptr);
    api.CompileShader(shader);

    GLint success = 0;

    api.GetShaderiv(shader, GL_COMPILE_STATUS, &success);

    if (!success) {
        GLint length = 0;

        api.GetShaderiv(shader, GL_INFO_LOG_LENGTH, &length);

        std::string log(std::max(length, 1), '\0');

        api.GetShaderInfoLog(shader, GLsizei(log.size()), nullptr, log.data());
        Diagnostics::failAt(
            __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Shader, kind == GL_VERTEX_SHADER ? "vertex shader" : "fragment shader",
            "GLSL file=" + sourcePath.u8string() + "\n" + log,
            "Read the compiler line number; check GLSL version, declarations and shader inputs/outputs.");
        api.DeleteShader(shader);

        return 0;
    }

    return shader;
}

bool validLayout(const VertexLayout& layout) {
    if (!layout.stride || layout.stride > std::size_t(std::numeric_limits<GLsizei>::max()) || layout.attributes.empty())
        return false;
    GLint maximum = 0;
    gl().GetIntegerv(GL_MAX_VERTEX_ATTRIBS, &maximum);
    std::vector<GLuint> used;
    for (const auto& a : layout.attributes) {
        std::size_t bytes = 0;
        switch (a.type) {
        case GL_BYTE: case GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE: bytes = 1; break;
        case GL_SHORT: case GL_UNSIGNED_SHORT: bytes = 2; break;
        case GL_INT: case GL_UNSIGNED_INT: case GL_FLOAT: bytes = 4; break;
        default: return false;
        }
        if (a.location >= GLuint(maximum) || a.components < 1 || a.components > 4 ||
            a.offset > layout.stride || std::size_t(a.components)*bytes > layout.stride-a.offset ||
            (a.integer && (a.normalized || a.type == GL_FLOAT)) ||
            std::find(used.begin(), used.end(), a.location) != used.end())
            return false;
        used.push_back(a.location);
    }
    return true;
}

GLuint uploadTexture(const TextureImage& image, bool repeat) {
    auto& api = gl();
    GLuint id = 0;

    api.GenTextures(1, &id);

    if (!id) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Asset, "glGenTextures", "Texture allocation failed.");

        return 0;
    }
    api.ActiveTexture(GL_TEXTURE0);
    api.BindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, id);

    GLint previousAlignment = 4;

    api.GetIntegerv(GL_UNPACK_ALIGNMENT, &previousAlignment);
    api.PixelStorei(GL_UNPACK_ALIGNMENT, 1);
    api.TexImage2D(GL_TEXTURE_2D, 0, GL_RGBA8, GLsizei(image.width), GLsizei(image.height), 0, GL_RGBA,
                   GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, image.rgba.data());
    api.PixelStorei(GL_UNPACK_ALIGNMENT, previousAlignment);
    api.TexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, GL_LINEAR);
    api.TexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, GL_LINEAR);
    api.TexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_S, repeat ? GL_REPEAT : GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
    api.TexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_T, repeat ? GL_REPEAT : GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE);

    if (!checkGlAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Asset, "uploadTexture")) {
        api.DeleteTextures(1, &id);

        return 0;
    }

    return id;
}
} // namespace detail

bool Renderer::initShader(const std::filesystem::path& vertexPath, const std::filesystem::path& fragmentPath) {
    auto& gl = detail::gl();
    const auto vertexText = vertexPath.empty() ? std::string(detail::vertexShader) : readTextFile(vertexPath);
    const auto fragmentText = fragmentPath.empty() ? std::string(detail::fragmentShader) : readTextFile(fragmentPath);

    if (vertexText.empty() || fragmentText.empty())
        return Diagnostics::failAt(
            __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Shader, "Renderer::initShader",
            "Shader source is empty or unreadable: vertex=" + vertexPath.u8string() +
                "; fragment=" + fragmentPath.u8string(),
            "Use embedded shaders (empty shaderDirectory), or copy both GLSL files to the configured project-relative directory.");
    // /utf-8 /FC encodes __FILE__ as UTF-8, not the Windows ANSI code page.
    const auto embeddedSource = std::filesystem::u8path(__FILE__).parent_path() / "Shaders.h";
    const auto vertex =
        detail::compileShader(GL_VERTEX_SHADER, vertexText, vertexPath.empty() ? embeddedSource : vertexPath);

    if (!vertex)
        return false;

    const auto fragment =
        detail::compileShader(GL_FRAGMENT_SHADER, fragmentText, fragmentPath.empty() ? embeddedSource : fragmentPath);

    if (!fragment) {
        gl.DeleteShader(vertex);

        return false;
    }
    shaderProgramID_ = gl.CreateProgram();

    if (!shaderProgramID_) {
        gl.DeleteShader(vertex);
        gl.DeleteShader(fragment);

        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Shader, "glCreateProgram",
                                   "Program allocation failed.");
    }
    gl.AttachShader(shaderProgramID_, vertex);
    gl.AttachShader(shaderProgramID_, fragment);
    gl.LinkProgram(shaderProgramID_);
    gl.DeleteShader(vertex);
    gl.DeleteShader(fragment);

    GLint success = 0;

    gl.GetProgramiv(shaderProgramID_, GL_LINK_STATUS, &success);

    if (!success) {
        GLint size = 0;

        gl.GetProgramiv(shaderProgramID_, GL_INFO_LOG_LENGTH, &size);

        std::string log(std::max(size, 1), '\0');

        gl.GetProgramInfoLog(shaderProgramID_, GLsizei(log.size()), nullptr, log.data());

        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Shader, "glLinkProgram", log,
                                   "Match vertex outputs and fragment inputs; inspect the linker log.");
    }
    mvpLocation_ = gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_, config_.uniforms.mvp.c_str());
    modelLocation_ = gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_, config_.uniforms.model.c_str());
    normalLocation_ = gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_, config_.uniforms.normal.c_str());
    textureLocation_ = gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_, config_.uniforms.texture.c_str());
    hasTextureLocation_ = gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_, config_.uniforms.hasTexture.c_str());
    lightingLocation_ = gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_, config_.uniforms.lighting.c_str());
    lightDirectionLocation_ = gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_, config_.uniforms.lightDirection.c_str());
    lightColorLocation_ = gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_, config_.uniforms.lightColor.c_str());
    overrideLocation_ = gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_, config_.uniforms.overrideColor.c_str());
    outlineColorLocation_ = gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_, config_.uniforms.outlineColor.c_str());
    tintLocation_ = gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_, config_.uniforms.tint.c_str());

    return mvpLocation_ >= 0 || (config_.uniforms.mvp.empty() && bool(config_.bindUniforms)) || Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Shader, "glGetUniformLocation",
                                                    "Required MVP uniform is missing or optimized away: " + config_.uniforms.mvp);
}

bool Renderer::initialize(const std::filesystem::path& vertexPath, const std::filesystem::path& fragmentPath,
                          const RenderConfig& config) {
    detail::gl().load();
    if (!detail::validLayout(config.vertexLayout) ||
        (!config.packVertices && config.vertexLayout.stride != sizeof(RenderVertex)))
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::VertexInput, "Renderer::initialize",
                                   "Invalid layout, or custom stride without a vertex packer.");
    const auto nextConfig = config; // Copy before destroying resources; config may alias current settings.
    destroy();
    config_ = nextConfig;

    if (!initShader(vertexPath, fragmentPath)) {
        destroy();

        return false;
    }

    auto& gl = detail::gl();

    gl.GenVertexArrays(1, &vao_);
    gl.GenBuffers(1, &vbo_);
    gl.GenBuffers(1, &ebo_);

    if (!vao_ || !vbo_ || !ebo_) {
        destroy();

        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::VertexInput, "Renderer::initialize",
                                   "VAO/VBO/EBO allocation failed.");
    }
    gl.BindVertexArray(vao_);
    gl.BindBuffer(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, vbo_);
    gl.BindBuffer(GL_ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, ebo_);
    for (const auto& attribute : config_.vertexLayout.attributes) {
        const auto pointer = reinterpret_cast<const void*>(attribute.offset);
        if (attribute.integer)
            gl.VertexAttribIPointer(attribute.location, attribute.components, attribute.type,
                                    GLsizei(config_.vertexLayout.stride), pointer);
        else
            gl.VertexAttribPointer(attribute.location, attribute.components, attribute.type,
                                   attribute.normalized ? GL_TRUE : GL_FALSE,
                                   GLsizei(config_.vertexLayout.stride), pointer);
        gl.EnableVertexAttribArray(attribute.location);
    }
    gl.BindVertexArray(0);
    gl.BindBuffer(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, 0);

    return detail::checkGlAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::VertexInput, "Renderer::initialize vertex layout");
}

bool Renderer::upload(const Scene& scene, bool textureMode) {
    Diagnostics::trace(PipelineStage::VertexInput, "Renderer::upload");

    std::vector<RenderVertex> vertices;
    std::vector<GLuint> indices;
    std::vector<DrawRange> ranges;
    TextureMap stagedTextures;
    auto& gl = detail::gl();
    auto cleanup = [&]() {
        for (const auto& item : stagedTextures)
            gl.DeleteTextures(1, &item.second);
    };

    try {
        for (auto id : scene.getIds()) {
            const auto* c = scene.getComponent(id);

            if (c && c->transformOnly)
                continue;

            if (!c || !DiagramSystem::validPolyhedron(c->polyhedron)) {
                cleanup();

                return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::VertexInput, "Renderer::upload",
                                           "Missing component or invalid mesh, indices, colors, UVs or normals.",
                                           "Inspect the entity's mesh data before GPU upload.", id);
            }

            for (std::size_t faceIndex = 0; faceIndex < c->polyhedron.faces.size(); ++faceIndex) {
                const auto& face = c->polyhedron.faces[faceIndex];

                if (vertices.size() + face.localVertices.size() > std::numeric_limits<GLuint>::max()) {
                    cleanup();

                    return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::VertexInput, "Renderer::upload",
                                               "Vertex count exceeds the GPU index range.");
                }

                const auto first = GLuint(vertices.size());
                Mesh normals = face;

                if (normals.vertexNormals.empty())
                    recalculateNormals(normals);

                for (std::size_t i = 0; i < face.localVertices.size(); ++i) {
                    const auto p = face.localVertices[i];
                    const auto n = normals.vertexNormals[i];
                    auto color = face.vertexColors.empty() ? face.color : face.vertexColors[i];

                    color.red *= face.material.color.red;
                    color.green *= face.material.color.green;
                    color.blue *= face.material.color.blue;

                    const auto uv = face.texcoords.empty() ? glm::vec2(0) : face.texcoords[i];

                    vertices.push_back(
                        {{p.x, p.y, p.z}, {color.red, color.green, color.blue}, {uv.x, uv.y}, {n.x, n.y, n.z}});
                }

                const auto triangles = detail::triangles(face);
                const auto outline =
                    meshOutline(face, face.outline == OutlineMode::None ? OutlineMode::FeatureEdges : face.outline);

                if (triangles.size() > std::numeric_limits<GLsizei>::max() ||
                    outline.size() > std::numeric_limits<GLsizei>::max()) {
                    cleanup();

                    return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::VertexInput, "Renderer::upload",
                                               "Draw count exceeds GLsizei range.");
                }

                DrawRange range;

                range.entityId = id;
                range.faceIndex = faceIndex;
                range.firstIndex = indices.size();
                range.count = GLsizei(triangles.size());

                for (auto index : triangles)
                    indices.push_back(first + index);
                range.outlineFirstIndex = indices.size();
                range.outlineCount = GLsizei(outline.size());

                for (auto index : outline)
                    indices.push_back(first + index);
                ranges.push_back(range);

                if (textureMode && face.material.useTexture &&
                    stagedTextures.find(face.material.texture) == stagedTextures.end()) {
                    if (!detail::checkGlAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Asset, "before uploadTexture")) {
                        cleanup();

                        return false;
                    }

                    const auto texture = detail::uploadTexture(*face.material.texture, face.material.repeatTexture);

                    if (!texture) {
                        cleanup();

                        return false;
                    }

                    try {
                        stagedTextures.emplace(face.material.texture, texture);
                    } catch (...) {
                        gl.DeleteTextures(1, &texture);
                        throw;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (std::size_t lineIndex = 0; lineIndex < scene.getLines().size(); ++lineIndex) {
            const auto& line = scene.getLines()[lineIndex];

            if (vertices.size() > std::numeric_limits<GLuint>::max() - 2) {
                cleanup();

                return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::VertexInput, "Renderer::upload lines",
                                           "Vertex count exceeds the GPU index range.");
            }

            const auto first = GLuint(vertices.size());

            for (auto p : {line.start, line.end})
                vertices.push_back(
                    {{p.x, p.y, p.z}, {line.color.red, line.color.green, line.color.blue}, {0, 0}, {0, 0, 0}});

            DrawRange range;

            range.lineId = lineIndex;
            range.firstIndex = indices.size();
            range.count = 2;
            ranges.push_back(range);
            indices.insert(indices.end(), {first, first + 1});
        }

        if (vertices.size() > std::size_t(std::numeric_limits<GLsizeiptr>::max()) / config_.vertexLayout.stride ||
            indices.size() > std::size_t(std::numeric_limits<GLsizeiptr>::max()) / sizeof(GLuint)) {
            cleanup();

            return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::VertexInput, "Renderer::upload",
                                       "Buffer byte size exceeds GLsizeiptr range.");
        }

        const auto byteCount = vertices.size() * config_.vertexLayout.stride;
        std::vector<std::uint8_t> packed;
        if (config_.packVertices) {
            if (!config_.packVertices(vertices, packed) || packed.size() != byteCount) {
                cleanup();
                return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::VertexInput, "packVertices",
                                           "Packer failed or byte count does not match vertex count times stride.");
            }
        } else {
            packed.resize(byteCount);
            if (byteCount)
                std::memcpy(packed.data(), vertices.data(), byteCount);
        }

        if (!detail::checkGlAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::VertexInput, "before buffer upload")) {
            cleanup();

            return false;
        }
        gl.BindVertexArray(vao_);
        gl.BindBuffer(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, vbo_);
        gl.BufferData(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, GLsizeiptr(packed.size()),
                      packed.empty() ? nullptr : packed.data(), GL_STATIC_DRAW);
        gl.BindBuffer(GL_ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, ebo_);
        gl.BufferData(GL_ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, GLsizeiptr(indices.size() * sizeof(GLuint)),
                      indices.empty() ? nullptr : indices.data(), GL_STATIC_DRAW);
        gl.BindVertexArray(0);
        gl.BindBuffer(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, 0);

        if (!detail::checkGlAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::VertexInput, "glBufferData")) {
            cleanup();

            return false;
        }

        for (const auto& item : textures_)
            gl.DeleteTextures(1, &item.second);
        textures_ = std::move(stagedTextures);
        drawRanges_ = std::move(ranges);

        return true;
    } catch (...) {
        cleanup();
        throw;
    }
}

bool Renderer::draw(const Scene& scene, const glm::mat4& view, const glm::mat4& projection,
                    const RenderOptions& options) const {
    Diagnostics::trace(PipelineStage::Transform, "Renderer::draw");

    if (!detail::finiteMatrix(view) || !detail::finiteMatrix(projection))
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Transform, "Renderer::draw",
                                   "View or projection matrix contains NaN/Inf.");

    for (const auto& range : drawRanges_) {
        glm::mat4 matrix(1);

        if (range.lineId) {
            const auto world = scene.lineWorldMatrix(*range.lineId);

            if (!world)
                return false;
            matrix = *world;
        } else {
            const auto* c = scene.getComponent(range.entityId);
            const auto world = scene.faceWorldMatrix(range.entityId, range.faceIndex);

            if (!world)
                return false;
            matrix = *world;
        }

        if (!detail::finiteMatrix(matrix) || !detail::finiteMatrix(projection * view * matrix))
            return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Transform, "Renderer::draw",
                                       "World or MVP matrix contains NaN/Inf.",
                                       "Check parent transforms, scales and motion samples.", range.entityId);
    }

    auto& gl = detail::gl();

    gl.UseProgram(shaderProgramID_);
    gl.BindVertexArray(vao_);

    auto cull = [&](const Mesh* face, const glm::mat4& model) {
        const auto mode = face && face->cull != CullMode::Inherit ? face->cull : options.cull;

        gl.FrontFace(glm::determinant(glm::mat3(model)) < 0 ? GL_CW : GL_CCW);

        if (!face || mode == CullMode::None || mode == CullMode::Inherit)
            gl.Disable(GL_CULL_FACE);
        else {
            gl.Enable(GL_CULL_FACE);
            gl.CullFace(mode == CullMode::Front ? GL_FRONT : GL_BACK);
        }
    };
    gl.ActiveTexture(GL_TEXTURE0);
    gl.Uniform1i(textureLocation_, 0);
    gl.Uniform3f(lightDirectionLocation_, options.lightDirection.x, options.lightDirection.y, options.lightDirection.z);
    gl.Uniform3f(lightColorLocation_, options.lightColor.red, options.lightColor.green, options.lightColor.blue);
    gl.Uniform3f(outlineColorLocation_, options.outlineColor.red, options.outlineColor.green,
                 options.outlineColor.blue);

    if (options.wireframe && options.depthTest) {
        // All surfaces write depth first, so a later object's front face hides earlier back edges.
        gl.ColorMask(GL_FALSE, GL_FALSE, GL_FALSE, GL_FALSE);

        for (const auto& range : drawRanges_) {
            if (range.lineId)
                continue;

            const auto* c = scene.getComponent(range.entityId);
            const auto& face = c->polyhedron.faces[range.faceIndex];

            if (!c->visible || !face.visible)
                continue;

            const auto model = *scene.faceWorldMatrix(range.entityId, range.faceIndex);

            cull(&face, model);

            const auto matrix = projection * view * model;

            gl.UniformMatrix4fv(mvpLocation_, 1, GL_FALSE, glm::value_ptr(matrix));
            if (config_.bindUniforms && !config_.bindUniforms(
                    {shaderProgramID_, scene, range.entityId, range.lineId, range.faceIndex, model, view, projection, true}))
                return false;
            gl.DrawElements(GL_TRIANGLES, range.count, GL_UNSIGNED_INT,
                            reinterpret_cast<const void*>(range.firstIndex * sizeof(GLuint)));
        }
        gl.ColorMask(GL_TRUE, GL_TRUE, GL_TRUE, GL_TRUE);
    }

    for (const auto& range : drawRanges_) {
        glm::mat4 model(1);
        const Mesh* face = nullptr;
        GlColor tint;

        if (range.lineId) {
            const auto& line = scene.getLines()[*range.lineId];

            if (line.owner) {
                const auto* owner = scene.getComponent(*line.owner);

                if (!owner || !owner->visible)
                    continue;
            }

            const auto world = scene.lineWorldMatrix(*range.lineId);

            if (!world)
                return false;
            model = *world;
        } else {
            const auto* c = scene.getComponent(range.entityId);

            if (!c || !c->visible)
                continue;
            face = &c->polyhedron.faces[range.faceIndex];

            if (!face->visible)
                continue;
            tint = c->tint;

            const auto world = scene.faceWorldMatrix(range.entityId, range.faceIndex);

            if (!world)
                return false;
            model = *world;
        }

        const auto mvp = projection * view * model;

        cull(face, model);

        const float determinant = glm::determinant(glm::mat3(model));
        const auto normalMatrix = std::isfinite(determinant) && std::abs(determinant) > 1e-12f
                                      ? glm::transpose(glm::inverse(glm::mat3(model)))
                                      : glm::mat3(1);

        gl.UniformMatrix4fv(mvpLocation_, 1, GL_FALSE, glm::value_ptr(mvp));
        gl.UniformMatrix4fv(modelLocation_, 1, GL_FALSE, glm::value_ptr(model));
        gl.UniformMatrix3fv(normalLocation_, 1, GL_FALSE, glm::value_ptr(normalMatrix));
        gl.Uniform3f(tintLocation_, tint.red, tint.green, tint.blue);
        gl.Uniform1i(lightingLocation_, face && options.lighting);
        gl.Uniform1i(overrideLocation_, 0);

        const bool textured = face && options.textures && face->material.useTexture;

        gl.Uniform1i(hasTextureLocation_, textured);

        if (textured) {
            gl.BindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, textures_.at(face->material.texture));
            gl.TexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_S,
                             face->material.repeatTexture ? GL_REPEAT : GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
            gl.TexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_T,
                             face->material.repeatTexture ? GL_REPEAT : GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
        } else
            gl.BindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, 0);

        if (config_.bindUniforms && !config_.bindUniforms(
                {shaderProgramID_, scene, range.lineId ? std::nullopt : std::optional<EntityId>(range.entityId),
                 range.lineId, range.faceIndex, model, view, projection, false}))
            return false;

        if (!face || !options.wireframe) {
            gl.DrawElements(face ? GL_TRIANGLES : GL_LINES, range.count, GL_UNSIGNED_INT,
                            reinterpret_cast<const void*>(range.firstIndex * sizeof(GLuint)));

            if (!detail::checkGlAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Raster, "glDrawElements")) {
                gl.BindVertexArray(0);
                gl.UseProgram(0);

                return false;
            }
        }

        if (face && (options.wireframe || face->outline != OutlineMode::None)) {
            gl.Uniform1i(hasTextureLocation_, 0);
            gl.Uniform1i(lightingLocation_, 0);
            gl.Uniform1i(overrideLocation_, options.wireframe ? 0 : 1);
            gl.DepthFunc(GL_LEQUAL);
            gl.DepthMask(GL_FALSE);
            gl.DrawElements(GL_LINES, range.outlineCount, GL_UNSIGNED_INT,
                            reinterpret_cast<const void*>(range.outlineFirstIndex * sizeof(GLuint)));
            gl.DepthFunc(GL_LESS);
            gl.DepthMask(GL_TRUE);
        }
    }
    gl.Uniform1i(overrideLocation_, 0);
    gl.BindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, 0);
    gl.BindVertexArray(0);
    gl.UseProgram(0);

    return detail::checkGlAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Raster, "Renderer::draw outlines and cleanup");
}

bool Renderer::renderPass(const Scene& scene, const RenderPass& pass, int width, int height) {
    Diagnostics::trace(PipelineStage::Framebuffer, "Renderer::renderPass");

    const auto& camera = pass.camera;
    const auto& options = pass.options;
    const auto& viewport = pass.viewport;

    if (!shaderProgramID_ || !vao_)
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::VertexInput, "Renderer::renderPass",
                                   "Renderer is not initialized.");

    if (width <= 0 || height <= 0)
        return true;

    if (viewport.x < 0 || viewport.y < 0 || viewport.x > width || viewport.y > height || viewport.width < 0 ||
        viewport.height < 0 || viewport.width > width - viewport.x || viewport.height > height - viewport.y)
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Framebuffer, "Renderer::renderPass",
                                   "Viewport lies outside the framebuffer.");

    if (viewport.width == 0 || viewport.height == 0)
        return true;

    if (!CameraSystem::validCamera(camera) || !detail::finiteVector(options.lightDirection) ||
        glm::length(options.lightDirection) < 1e-12f || !detail::validColor(options.lightColor) ||
        !detail::validColor(options.outlineColor) || !std::isfinite(options.background.r) ||
        !std::isfinite(options.background.g) || !std::isfinite(options.background.b) ||
        !std::isfinite(options.background.a) ||
        (options.cull != CullMode::Inherit && options.cull != CullMode::None && options.cull != CullMode::Back &&
         options.cull != CullMode::Front))
        return Diagnostics::failAt(
            __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Transform, "Renderer::renderPass",
            "Invalid camera, light, color or culling mode.",
            "Check near/far planes, FOV, target/up directions, positive orthographic extent and finite render options.");

    if (uploadedScene_ != &scene || uploadedRevision_ != scene.getGeometryRevision() ||
        uploadedTextures_ != options.textures) {
        if (!upload(scene, options.textures))
            return false;
        uploadedScene_ = &scene;
        uploadedRevision_ = scene.getGeometryRevision();
        uploadedTextures_ = options.textures;
    }

    auto& gl = detail::gl();

    if (!detail::checkGlAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Framebuffer, "before Renderer::render"))
        return false;
    gl.Viewport(viewport.x, viewport.y, viewport.width, viewport.height);
    gl.LineWidth(1);

    if (options.depthTest)
        gl.Enable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
    else
        gl.Disable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
    gl.Disable(GL_CULL_FACE);
    gl.Disable(GL_BLEND);
    gl.Enable(GL_SCISSOR_TEST);
    gl.Scissor(viewport.x, viewport.y, viewport.width, viewport.height);
    gl.PolygonMode(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_FILL);
    gl.DepthFunc(GL_LESS);
    gl.DepthMask(GL_TRUE);
    gl.ColorMask(GL_TRUE, GL_TRUE, GL_TRUE, GL_TRUE);
    gl.ClearColor(options.background.r, options.background.g, options.background.b, options.background.a);

    const GLbitfield mask = (pass.clearColor ? GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT : 0) | (pass.clearDepth ? GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT : 0);

    if (mask)
        gl.Clear(mask);

    if (!detail::checkGlAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Framebuffer, "viewport/scissor/clear")) {
        gl.Disable(GL_SCISSOR_TEST);

        return false;
    }

    const bool success = draw(scene, CameraSystem::viewMatrix(camera),
                              CameraSystem::projectionMatrix(camera, float(viewport.width) / viewport.height), options);

    gl.Disable(GL_SCISSOR_TEST);
    gl.Disable(GL_CULL_FACE);
    gl.FrontFace(GL_CCW);

    return success;
}

bool Renderer::render(const Scene& scene, const Camera& camera, int width, int height, const RenderOptions& options) {
    RenderPass pass;

    pass.camera = camera;
    pass.options = options;
    pass.viewport = {0, 0, width, height};

    return renderPass(scene, pass, width, height);
}

bool Renderer::renderViews(const Scene& scene, const std::vector<RenderPass>& passes, int width, int height) {
    if (width <= 0 || height <= 0)
        return true;

    if (passes.empty())
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Framebuffer, "Renderer::renderViews",
                                   "Need at least one render pass.");

    if (!shaderProgramID_ || !vao_)
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::VertexInput, "Renderer::renderViews",
                                   "Renderer is not initialized.");

    auto& gl = detail::gl();

    gl.Disable(GL_SCISSOR_TEST);
    gl.Viewport(0, 0, width, height);
    gl.DepthMask(GL_TRUE);
    gl.ColorMask(GL_TRUE, GL_TRUE, GL_TRUE, GL_TRUE);
    gl.ClearColor(.08f, .08f, .1f, 1);
    gl.Clear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);

    if (!detail::checkGlAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Framebuffer, "Renderer::renderViews full-frame clear"))
        return false;

    for (const auto& pass : passes)
        if (!renderPass(scene, pass, width, height))
            return false;

    return true;
}

void Renderer::destroy() {
    auto& gl = detail::gl();

    if (ebo_)
        gl.DeleteBuffers(1, &ebo_);

    if (vbo_)
        gl.DeleteBuffers(1, &vbo_);

    if (vao_)
        gl.DeleteVertexArrays(1, &vao_);

    if (shaderProgramID_)
        gl.DeleteProgram(shaderProgramID_);

    for (const auto& item : textures_)
        gl.DeleteTextures(1, &item.second);
    textures_.clear();
    drawRanges_.clear();
    ebo_ = vbo_ = vao_ = shaderProgramID_ = 0;
    uploadedScene_ = nullptr;
    uploadedRevision_ = std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max();
    uploadedTextures_ = false;
}
} // namespace graphics
실제 저장소 소스 · framework/detail/Shaders.h
#pragma once

namespace graphics::detail {
inline constexpr char vertexShader[] = R"GLSL(#version 330 core
layout(location=0) in vec3 vPos;
layout(location=1) in vec3 vColor;
layout(location=2) in vec2 vTexCoord;
layout(location=3) in vec3 vNormal;
uniform mat4 uMVP;
uniform mat4 uModel;
uniform mat3 uNormalMatrix;
out vec3 outColor;
out vec2 TexCoord;
out vec3 Normal;
void main() {
    gl_Position = uMVP * vec4(vPos, 1.0);
    outColor = vColor;
    TexCoord = vTexCoord;
    Normal = uNormalMatrix * vNormal;
}
)GLSL";
inline constexpr char fragmentShader[] = R"GLSL(#version 330 core
in vec3 outColor;
in vec2 TexCoord;
in vec3 Normal;
uniform sampler2D uTexture;
uniform bool uHasTexture;
uniform bool uLighting;
uniform vec3 uLightDirection;
uniform vec3 uLightColor;
uniform bool uOverrideColor;
uniform vec3 uOutlineColor;
uniform vec3 uTint;
out vec4 FragColor;
void main() {
    if (uOverrideColor) { FragColor = vec4(uOutlineColor, 1.0); return; }
    vec4 color = vec4(outColor * uTint, 1.0);
    if (uHasTexture) color *= texture(uTexture, TexCoord);
    if (uLighting && length(Normal) > 0.0)
        color.rgb *= (0.25 + 0.75 * max(dot(normalize(Normal), normalize(uLightDirection)), 0.0)) * uLightColor;
    FragColor = color;
}
)GLSL";
}

마우스 픽셀을 객체 선택과 배치 위치로 바꾸기

왼쪽 클릭으로 선택한 상자의 면을 찾고, 빈 바닥 클릭은 Y=0 평면 위치로 바꾼다. 창 좌표와 framebuffer 픽셀은 DPI 배율 때문에 다를 수 있으므로 좌표계를 맞춘다.

변수·객체 역할. viewport는 왼쪽 위 원점의 픽셀 사각형이다. ray는 near plane에서 시작하며 direction은 정규화된다. hit에는 객체·면·삼각형 번호와 월드/로컬 교차점·UV가 들어 있다.

새로 작성한 사용 사례 · 단편별 전제는 본문 참조 · 빌드하지 않음

void selectAt(const graphics::Scene& scene,const graphics::Camera& camera,double x,double y) {
    graphics::PickViewport viewport{0,0,1100,800};
    auto ray=graphics::screenRay(camera,x,y,viewport);
    if(!ray) return;
    auto first=graphics::pick(scene,*ray);
    auto second=graphics::pick(scene,camera,x,y,viewport);
    auto floor=graphics::PatternSystem::screenOnPlane(camera,x,y,viewport,{0,0,0},{0,1,0});
    if(first) { auto id=first->entityId; auto face=first->faceIndex; (void)id;(void)face; }
    if(floor) { glm::vec3 placement=*floor; (void)placement; }
    (void)second;
}

화면 밖 좌표, 평행한 평면, 또는 물체를 맞히지 않은 클릭은 빈 optional이 정상 결과다. 빈 결과를 시스템 오류로 처리하지 않는다.

실제 저장소 소스 · framework/include/Picking.h
#pragma once
#include "Graphics.h"

namespace graphics {
struct Ray {
    glm::vec3 origin{0}, direction{0, 0, -1};
    float maxDistance = std::numeric_limits<float>::infinity();
};

struct PickResult {
    EntityId entityId = 0;
    std::size_t faceIndex = 0, triangleIndex = 0;
    glm::vec3 worldPoint{0}, localPoint{0}, barycentric{0};
    glm::vec2 uv{0};
    bool hasUV = false;
    float distance = 0; // Distance from ray origin (near plane for a screen ray).
};

struct PickViewport {
    double x = 0, y = 0, width = 0, height = 0;
}; // top-left framebuffer pixels

/// [API] 왼쪽 위 기준 프레임버퍼 픽셀을 카메라 ray로 역투영한다. 영역 밖/잘못된 투영이면 빈 결과다.
inline std::optional<Ray> screenRay(const Camera& camera, double x, double y, const PickViewport& viewport) {
    if (!CameraSystem::validCamera(camera) || !std::isfinite(x) || !std::isfinite(y) || !std::isfinite(viewport.x) ||
        !std::isfinite(viewport.y) || !std::isfinite(viewport.width) || !std::isfinite(viewport.height) ||
        viewport.width <= 0 || viewport.height <= 0 || x < viewport.x || y < viewport.y ||
        x >= viewport.x + viewport.width || y >= viewport.y + viewport.height)
        return {};

    const auto pv = CameraSystem::projectionMatrix(camera, float(viewport.width / viewport.height)) *
                    CameraSystem::viewMatrix(camera);
    const auto determinant = glm::determinant(pv);

    if (!std::isfinite(determinant) || std::abs(determinant) < 1e-12f)
        return {};

    const auto inverse = glm::inverse(pv);
    const float nx = float(2 * (x - viewport.x) / viewport.width - 1),
                ny = float(1 - 2 * (y - viewport.y) / viewport.height);
    auto nearPoint = inverse * glm::vec4(nx, ny, -1, 1), farPoint = inverse * glm::vec4(nx, ny, 1, 1);

    if (std::abs(nearPoint.w) < 1e-12f || std::abs(farPoint.w) < 1e-12f)
        return {};
    nearPoint /= nearPoint.w;
    farPoint /= farPoint.w;

    const auto direction = glm::vec3(farPoint - nearPoint);
    const auto length = glm::length(direction);

    if (!detail::finiteVector(glm::vec3(nearPoint)) || !detail::finiteVector(direction) || !std::isfinite(length) ||
        length <= 0)
        return {};

    return Ray{glm::vec3(nearPoint), direction / length, length};
}

/// [API] ray 또는 화면 좌표로 보이는 삼각형의 최근접 교차를 찾아 객체·면·위치·UV를 반환한다.
inline std::optional<PickResult> pick(const Scene& scene, const Ray& input) {
    if (!detail::finiteVector(input.origin) || !detail::finiteVector(input.direction) ||
        !std::isfinite(glm::length(input.direction)) || glm::length(input.direction) < 1e-12f ||
        std::isnan(input.maxDistance) || input.maxDistance < 0)
        return {};

    const auto direction = glm::dvec3(glm::normalize(input.direction));
    const auto origin = glm::dvec3(input.origin);
    double nearest = input.maxDistance;
    std::optional<PickResult> result;

    for (auto id : scene.getIds()) {
        const auto* component = scene.getComponent(id);

        if (!component || !component->visible)
            continue;

        for (std::size_t f = 0; f < component->polyhedron.faces.size(); ++f) {
            const auto& face = component->polyhedron.faces[f];

            if (!face.visible)
                continue;

            const auto world = scene.faceWorldMatrix(id, f);

            if (!world)
                continue;

            const auto matrix = *world;
            const auto indices = detail::triangles(face);

            for (std::size_t t = 0; t < indices.size(); t += 3) {
                const auto ia = indices[t], ib = indices[t + 1], ic = indices[t + 2];
                const auto a4 = matrix * glm::vec4(face.localVertices[ia], 1),
                           b4 = matrix * glm::vec4(face.localVertices[ib], 1),
                           c4 = matrix * glm::vec4(face.localVertices[ic], 1);

                if (std::abs(a4.w) < 1e-12f || std::abs(b4.w) < 1e-12f || std::abs(c4.w) < 1e-12f)
                    continue;

                const auto a = glm::dvec3(a4 / a4.w), b = glm::dvec3(b4 / b4.w), c = glm::dvec3(c4 / c4.w);
                const auto edge1 = b - a, edge2 = c - a, p = glm::cross(direction, edge2);
                const auto determinant = glm::dot(edge1, p);
                const auto tolerance = 1e-12 * glm::length(edge1) * glm::length(edge2);

                if (!std::isfinite(determinant) || std::abs(determinant) <= tolerance)
                    continue;

                const auto relative = origin - a;
                const auto u = glm::dot(relative, p) / determinant;

                if (u < 0 || u > 1)
                    continue;

                const auto q = glm::cross(relative, edge1);
                const auto v = glm::dot(direction, q) / determinant;

                if (v < 0 || u + v > 1)
                    continue;

                const auto distance = glm::dot(edge2, q) / determinant;

                if (!std::isfinite(distance) || distance < 0 || distance > nearest)
                    continue;

                const glm::dvec3 weights((1 - u - v) / a4.w, u / b4.w, v / c4.w);
                const auto sum = weights.x + weights.y + weights.z;

                if (std::abs(sum) < 1e-12)
                    continue;

                PickResult hit;

                hit.entityId = id;
                hit.faceIndex = f;
                hit.triangleIndex = t / 3;
                hit.distance = float(distance);
                hit.worldPoint = glm::vec3(origin + direction * distance);
                hit.barycentric = glm::vec3(weights / sum);
                hit.localPoint = face.localVertices[ia] * hit.barycentric.x +
                                 face.localVertices[ib] * hit.barycentric.y +
                                 face.localVertices[ic] * hit.barycentric.z;
                hit.hasUV = !face.texcoords.empty();

                if (hit.hasUV)
                    hit.uv = face.texcoords[ia] * hit.barycentric.x + face.texcoords[ib] * hit.barycentric.y +
                             face.texcoords[ic] * hit.barycentric.z;
                nearest = distance;
                result = hit;
            }
        }
    }

    return result;
}

/// [API] ray 또는 화면 좌표로 보이는 삼각형의 최근접 교차를 찾아 객체·면·위치·UV를 반환한다.
inline std::optional<PickResult> pick(const Scene& scene, const Camera& camera, double x, double y,
                                      const PickViewport& viewport) {
    const auto ray = screenRay(camera, x, y, viewport);

    return ray ? pick(scene, *ray) : std::nullopt;
}
} // namespace graphics
실제 저장소 소스 · framework/examples/basic.cpp
#include "../Framework.h"
#include <iostream>

int main() {
    graphics::Application app;

    app.setInitHandler([](graphics::Application& app) {
        auto& scene = app.getScene();
        const auto id = scene.addCuboid({1, 1, 1}, {0, 0, 0});

        if (!id)
            return false;

        graphics::Transform3D parent;

        parent.rotation = glm::mat3(
            glm::rotate(glm::rotate(glm::mat4(1), glm::radians(15.0f), {1, 0, 0}), glm::radians(25.0f), {0, 1, 0}));
        parent.scale = {1.2f, .8f, 1};

        if (!scene.setTransform(*id, parent))
            return false;

        for (std::size_t face = 0; face < 6; ++face)
            if (!scene.setOutline(*id, face, graphics::OutlineMode::FeatureEdges))
                return false;

        return true;
    });
    app.setMouseHandler([](graphics::Application& app, const graphics::MouseEvent& event) {
        if (event.button != GLFW_MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT || event.action != GLFW_PRESS)
            return;

        const auto hit = app.pickAt(event.windowX, event.windowY);

        if (!hit)
            return;

        auto& scene = app.getScene();
        const auto* face = scene.getMesh(hit->entityId, hit->faceIndex);
        graphics::Transform3D child;

        for (const auto& vertex : face->localVertices)
            child.localBasis += vertex;
        child.localBasis /= float(face->localVertices.size());
        child.basis = face->normal * .25f;
        child.rotation = glm::mat3(glm::rotate(glm::mat4(1), glm::radians(20.0f), {0, 0, 1}));
        scene.splitFace(hit->entityId, hit->faceIndex);
        scene.setFaceSRT(hit->entityId, hit->faceIndex, child);
        std::cout << "entity=" << hit->entityId << " face=" << hit->faceIndex << '\n';
    });
    app.setKeyHandler([](graphics::Application& app, int key, int action) {
        if (key == GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE && action == GLFW_PRESS)
            app.requestClose();
    });

    return app.run();
}

OBJ·이미지 로딩을 실제 초기화 시점에 연결하기

외부 모델과 한 장의 텍스처를 불러온다. 상대경로는 실행 파일 기준 projectRoot 안에서 해석된다. 모델 파일에 담긴 피벗 결과를 addModel에 그대로 전달해야 발 기준 배치가 유지된다.

변수·객체 역할. loaded는 CPU 모델과 피벗·경고·오류를 묶은 ModelResult다. texture.image는 공유 이미지다. features.textures는 로딩 기능, RenderOptions.textures는 그리기 기능을 켠다.

새로 작성한 사용 사례 · 단편별 전제는 본문 참조 · 빌드하지 않음

bool loadAssets(graphics::Application& app) { // initHandler 안에서 호출
    auto& loader=app.getAssets();
    const auto& features=loader.features(); (void)features;
    graphics::LoadOptions options; options.texturePath="textures/robot.png";
    auto loaded=loader.loadObj("models/robot.obj",options);
    if(!loaded) { std::cerr<<loaded.error; return false; }
    auto texture=loader.loadTexture("textures/robot.png");
    if(!texture) { std::cerr<<texture.error; return false; }
    if(!texture.image->valid()) return false;
    auto id=app.getScene().addModel(*loaded.model,{},loaded.pivotMode,loaded.localBasis);
    app.getRenderOptions().textures=true;
    return id.has_value();
}
void standaloneLoader() {
    graphics::FeatureOptions features; features.textures=true;
    graphics::AssetLoader loader(".",features);
    auto a=loader.loadPrimitive("models/cube.obj");
    auto b=loader.loadModel("models/robot.obj");
    graphics::TextureImage pixel; pixel.width=1;pixel.height=1;pixel.rgba={255,255,255,255};
    bool valid=pixel.valid(); (void)a;(void)b;(void)valid;
}
// main에서 config.features.textures=true를 설정한 뒤 app.run(config)를 호출한다.

이 경로는 사용자가 준비해야 하는 사례 자산이다. loadPrimitive/loadModel도 현재는 OBJ 로더를 호출한다. FBX/glTF 로딩을 의미하지 않는다. 이미지 기능을 끄면 해당 로드는 error를 돌려준다.

실제 저장소 소스 · framework/examples/assets.cpp
#include "../Framework.h"
#include <iostream>

// assets.exe obj framework/examples/data/cube.obj
// assets.exe obj models/example.obj textures/override.png
// The old primitive/model mode names remain aliases of obj.
int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    if (argc < 3) {
        std::cerr << "Use: assets.exe obj|primitive|model relative-path [relative-texture-path]\n";

        return 1;
    }

    const std::string mode = argv[1];

    if (mode != "obj" && mode != "primitive" && mode != "model") {
        std::cerr << "Unknown mode\n";

        return 1;
    }

    const auto path = std::filesystem::u8path(argv[2]);
    const auto texturePath = argc > 3 ? std::filesystem::u8path(argv[3]) : std::filesystem::path{};
    graphics::ApplicationConfig config;

    config.projectRoot = ".";
    config.features.textures = !texturePath.empty();

    graphics::Application app;

    app.setInitHandler([&](graphics::Application& app) {
        graphics::LoadOptions options;

        options.outline = graphics::OutlineMode::FeatureEdges;
        options.texturePath = texturePath;

        const auto loaded = app.getAssets().loadObj(path, options);

        if (!loaded)
            return false; // loadObj already printed the error and format guidance.

        for (const auto& warning : loaded.warnings)
            std::cerr << warning << '\n';

        return app.getScene()
            .addModel(*loaded.model, graphics::Transform3D{}, loaded.pivotMode, loaded.localBasis)
            .has_value();
    });
    app.setMouseHandler([](graphics::Application& app, const graphics::MouseEvent& event) {
        if (event.button == GLFW_MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT && event.action == GLFW_PRESS)
            if (const auto hit = app.pickAtCursor())
                std::cout << "entity=" << hit->entityId << " mesh=" << hit->faceIndex
                          << " triangle=" << hit->triangleIndex << '\n';
    });
    app.setKeyHandler([](graphics::Application& app, int key, int action) {
        if (key == GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE && action == GLFW_PRESS)
            app.requestClose();
    });

    return app.run(config);
}
실제 저장소 소스 · framework/include/ModelLoader.h
#pragma once
#include "Geometry.h"
#include "Texture.h"

namespace graphics {
struct FeatureOptions {
    bool textures = false;
};

struct LoadOptions {
    PivotMode pivot = PivotMode::BottomCenter;
    glm::vec3 customPivot{0};
    OutlineMode outline = OutlineMode::None;
    bool mergeCoplanarFaces = true; // within each OBJ object/group/material/smoothing segment
    bool flipTextureRows = true;

    std::filesystem::path texturePath; // project-relative explicit override

    bool allowObjFallback = true;
};

struct ModelResult {
    std::optional<Model> model;
    glm::vec3 localBasis{0};
    PivotMode pivotMode = PivotMode::Preserve;
    std::string error;
    std::vector<std::string> warnings;
    bool usedFallback = false;

    /// [API] 모델 또는 이미지 결과가 있는지 성공 여부로 변환한다. 실패 시 error 문자열을 확인한다.
    explicit operator bool() const {
        return model.has_value();
    }
};

struct TextureResult {
    std::shared_ptr<const TextureImage> image;
    std::string error;

    /// [API] 모델 또는 이미지 결과가 있는지 성공 여부로 변환한다. 실패 시 error 문자열을 확인한다.
    explicit operator bool() const {
        return bool(image);
    }
};

namespace detail {
inline ModelResult finishLoad(Model model, const LoadOptions& options) {
    if (model.faces.empty())
        throw std::runtime_error("Model contains no triangle meshes.");

    for (auto& face : model.faces) {
        face.outline = options.outline;

        if (!validMesh(face))
            throw std::runtime_error("Invalid model mesh data.");
    }

    ModelResult result;

    if (options.pivot == PivotMode::BottomCenter)
        result.localBasis = bottomCenter(model);
    else if (options.pivot == PivotMode::Custom)
        result.localBasis = options.customPivot;

    if (!finiteVector(result.localBasis))
        throw std::runtime_error("Invalid local basis.");
    result.pivotMode = options.pivot;
    result.model = std::move(model);

    return result;
}
} // namespace detail

class AssetLoader {
    std::filesystem::path projectRoot_;

    FeatureOptions features_;

    mutable std::map<std::filesystem::path, std::weak_ptr<const TextureImage>> imageCache_;

    std::filesystem::path resolve(const std::filesystem::path& relative) const {
        if (relative.empty() || relative.is_absolute() || relative.has_root_name())
            throw std::runtime_error("Asset path must be project-relative.");

        const auto root = std::filesystem::weakly_canonical(projectRoot_);
        const auto full = std::filesystem::weakly_canonical(root / relative);
        auto a = root.begin(), b = full.begin();

        for (; a != root.end(); ++a, ++b)
            if (b == full.end() || *a != *b)
                throw std::runtime_error("Asset path is outside projectRoot.");

        return full;
    }

    std::shared_ptr<const TextureImage> texture(const std::filesystem::path& relative, bool flip) const {
        if (!features_.textures)
            throw std::runtime_error("Texture mode is disabled.");

        const auto full = resolve(relative);
        // The row convention is part of the cache key.
        const auto key = full / (flip ? "#flipped" : "#native");

        if (auto cached = imageCache_[key].lock())
            return cached;

        auto image = std::make_shared<const TextureImage>(detail::decodeImage(full, nullptr, flip));

        imageCache_[key] = image;

        return image;
    }

public:
    /// [API] 프로젝트 루트와 기능 옵션을 보관하고 상대경로 자산 로딩을 준비한다.
    explicit AssetLoader(std::filesystem::path projectRoot = detail::executableDirectory(),
                         FeatureOptions features = FeatureOptions{})
        : projectRoot_(std::filesystem::absolute(projectRoot)), features_(features) {
    }

    /// [API] 로더의 텍스처 등 기능 사용 옵션을 읽기 전용 참조로 반환한다.
    const FeatureOptions& features() const {
        return features_;
    }

    /// [API] 프로젝트 상대경로의 이미지를 읽어 TextureResult로 반환한다. 실패 원인은 error에 담는다.
    TextureResult loadTexture(const std::filesystem::path& relative, bool flipRows = true) const {
        try {
            return {texture(relative, flipRows), {}};
        } catch (const std::exception& e) {
            return {nullptr, e.what()};
        }
    }

    /// [API] 프로젝트 상대경로의 OBJ를 직접 파싱하여 모델·피벗·경고·오류 결과를 반환한다.
    ModelResult loadObj(const std::filesystem::path& relative, const LoadOptions& options = LoadOptions{}) const;
    /// [API] 기본 도형 OBJ를 읽는 호환 진입점이다. OBJ 로더로 처리를 위임한다.
    ModelResult loadPrimitive(const std::filesystem::path& relative, const LoadOptions& options = LoadOptions{}) const;
    /// [API] 모델 로딩 호환 진입점이다. 현재 구현은 loadObj로 위임하며 다른 형식 변환은 하지 않는다.
    ModelResult loadModel(const std::filesystem::path& relative, const LoadOptions& options = LoadOptions{}) const;
};
} // namespace graphics

namespace graphics {
/// [API] 모델 로딩 호환 진입점이다. 현재 구현은 loadObj로 위임하며 다른 형식 변환은 하지 않는다.
inline ModelResult AssetLoader::loadModel(const std::filesystem::path& relative, const LoadOptions& options) const {
    return loadObj(relative, options);
}
} // namespace graphics

실패한 작업의 위치·원인·조치 남기기

장면 조립 실패가 어느 함수에서 발생했는지 찾는 상황이다. bool만 출력하지 않고 소스 위치와 객체 ID를 같이 기록하면 잘못된 값이 들어온 경로를 추적할 수 있다.

변수·객체 역할. context는 다음 오류에 붙는 문맥이다. lastError는 마지막 오류 기록이며 clear는 설정을 끄는 동작이 아니다. trace 옵션은 단계 진입 로그의 출력 여부다.

새로 작성한 사용 사례 · 단편별 전제는 본문 참조 · 빌드하지 않음

void explainFailure() {
    graphics::Diagnostics::configure({true,true});
    graphics::Diagnostics::locate(__FILE__,__LINE__,"robot initialization");
    auto operation=graphics::Diagnostics::context().operation;
    graphics::Diagnostics::trace(graphics::PipelineStage::Scene,"attach head");
    // 아래는 의도적으로 실패 기록을 만드는 진단 사용 사례다.
    bool accepted=graphics::Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,graphics::PipelineStage::Scene,
        "attach head","부모 ID가 없음","부모를 먼저 생성",42);
    accepted=graphics::Diagnostics::fail(graphics::PipelineStage::Motion,"walk","주기가 0","양수 주기 지정");
    const auto& last=graphics::Diagnostics::lastError();
    if(last) std::cerr<<graphics::Diagnostics::stageName(last->stage)<<": "<<last->cause;
    graphics::Diagnostics::clear();
    (void)operation;(void)accepted;
}

fail/failAt은 false를 반환하므로 호출 함수의 실패 반환으로 연결할 수 있다. trace가 출력되었다는 사실은 GPU 결과가 맞다는 증거가 아니다.

실제 저장소 소스 · framework/include/Diagnostics.h
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <iostream>
#include <optional>
#include <string>

namespace graphics {
enum class PipelineStage { Runtime, Input, Scene, Motion, VertexInput, Shader, Transform, Raster, Framebuffer, Asset };

struct DiagnosticOptions {
    bool errors = true;
    bool trace = false;
};

struct Diagnostic {
    PipelineStage stage = PipelineStage::Runtime;
    std::string api, cause, action;
    std::optional<std::uint64_t> object;
    std::string file, operation;
    int line = 0;
};

class Diagnostics {
    static DiagnosticOptions& options() {
        static DiagnosticOptions value;

        return value;
    }

    static std::optional<Diagnostic>& issue() {
        static std::optional<Diagnostic> value;

        return value;
    }

public:
    /// [API] 진단에 첨부할 현재 파일·줄·호출 경로 문맥의 참조를 반환한다.
    static Diagnostic& context() {
        static Diagnostic value;

        return value;
    }

    /// [API] 다음 진단에 사용할 소스 파일·줄 번호·호출 경로를 설정한다.
    static void locate(const char* file, int line, const char* operation) {
        context().file = file;
        context().line = line;
        context().operation = operation;
    }

    /// [API] 주어진 소스 위치와 API 오류를 기록·출력하고 이전 진단 문맥을 복원한 뒤 false를 반환한다.
    static bool failAt(const char* file, int line, PipelineStage stage, const char* api, const std::string& cause,
                       const std::string& action = "소스 위치와 해당 API의 입력 조건을 확인하세요.",
                       std::optional<std::uint64_t> object = std::nullopt) {
        const auto saved = context();

        locate(file, line, api);

        if (!saved.operation.empty())
            context().operation = saved.operation + " -> " + api;

        const bool result = fail(stage, api, cause, action, object);

        context() = saved;

        return result;
    }

    /// [API] 파이프라인 단계 열거값에 대응하는 로그용 문자열을 반환한다.
    static const char* stageName(PipelineStage stage) {
        switch (stage) {
        case PipelineStage::Runtime:
            return "runtime";
        case PipelineStage::Input:
            return "input";
        case PipelineStage::Scene:
            return "scene";
        case PipelineStage::Motion:
            return "motion";
        case PipelineStage::VertexInput:
            return "vertex-input";
        case PipelineStage::Shader:
            return "shader";
        case PipelineStage::Transform:
            return "transform";
        case PipelineStage::Raster:
            return "raster";
        case PipelineStage::Framebuffer:
            return "framebuffer";
        case PipelineStage::Asset:
            return "asset";
        }

        return "알 수 없음";
    }

    /// [API] 오류 출력과 단계 추적 출력의 사용 여부를 설정한다.
    static void configure(DiagnosticOptions value) {
        options() = value;
    }

    /// [API] 마지막으로 기록한 오류의 optional 참조를 반환한다.
    static const std::optional<Diagnostic>& lastError() {
        return issue();
    }

    /// [API] 마지막 오류 기록을 지운다. 진단 설정과 현재 위치 문맥은 유지한다.
    static void clear() {
        issue().reset();
    }

    /// [API] 추적 옵션이 켜져 있으면 해당 단계·API의 시작을 콘솔에 출력한다.
    static void trace(PipelineStage stage, const char* api) {
        if (options().trace)
            std::clog << "[OpenGL][" << stageName(stage) << "][" << api << "] 시작\n";
    }

    /// [API] 현재 진단 문맥에서 원인·조치·객체 ID를 저장하고 출력한 뒤 false를 반환한다.
    static bool fail(
        PipelineStage stage, const char* api, const std::string& cause,
        const std::string& action = "framework/docs/API_KO.md에서 해당 API의 입력 조건과 반환값을 확인하세요.",
        std::optional<std::uint64_t> object = std::nullopt) {
        issue() = Diagnostic{stage, api, cause, action, object};
        issue()->file = context().file;
        issue()->line = context().line;
        issue()->operation = context().operation;

        if (options().errors) {
            std::cerr << "[OpenGL][" << stageName(stage) << "][" << api << "] 오류";

            if (object)
                std::cerr << " 객체=" << *object;
            std::cerr << ": " << cause << "\n  조치: " << action << '\n';
            std::cerr << "  소스: " << context().file << ':' << context().line
                      << "\n  호출 경로: " << context().operation << '\n';
        }

        return false;
    }
};
} // namespace graphics

격자 비율·셀 번호로 반복 배치하기

가로 10칸 바닥에 장애물을 배치한다. 셀 번호는 이산 인덱스이고 비율은 전체 영역을 0~1로 표현하는 연속 값이다. 두 입력의 의미를 섞지 않는다.

변수·객체 역할. origin은 최소 모서리, extent는 전체 크기, cells는 분할 수다. frame은 격자 좌표를 월드로 바꾼다. parentWorld는 배치할 부모의 월드 행렬이다.

새로 작성한 사용 사례 · 단편별 전제는 본문 참조 · 빌드하지 않음

bool placeOnGrid(graphics::Scene& scene) {
    graphics::GridLayout grid; grid.origin={-5,0,-5}; grid.extent={10,2,10};grid.cells={10,2,10};
    if(!grid.valid()) return false;
    auto middle=grid.position({.5f,0,.5f});
    auto cell=grid.cellCenter({2,0,3});
    auto size=grid.relativeSize({.1f,.25f,.1f});
    auto local=grid.positionInParent({.5f,0,.5f},glm::mat4(1));
    if(!middle||!cell||!size||!local) return false;
    auto index=grid.cellAt(*cell); if(!index) return false;
    auto order=graphics::PatternSystem::snakeCells({10,1,10}); (void)order;
    auto snapped=graphics::PatternSystem::snap(*cell,1);
    bool aligned=graphics::PatternSystem::aligned(snapped.x,cell->x,.01f); (void)aligned;
    return graphics::PatternSystem::addBox(scene,*size,*cell,{.6f,.7f,.8f}).has_value();
}

cellCenter({2,0,3})는 (-2.5,.5,-1.5)다. relativeSize는 로컬 크기를 반환하므로 frame의 비균일 배율을 이미 적용한 월드 크기로 착각하지 않는다.

실제 저장소 소스 · standard/Console.cpp
#include "Console.h"
#include <iostream>

/// 선택한 경로로 이동 모션을 바꾼다.
bool Console::choosePath(int kind) {
    graphics::PathMotion path;

    path.durationSeconds = 6;

    const glm::vec3 center(1.7f, 0, 0);

    if (kind == 1) {
        path.path = graphics::PathSystem::ellipse(center, {.8f, 0, 0}, {0, .5f, 0});
    } else if (kind == 2) {
        path.path = graphics::PathSystem::rectangle(center, {.8f, 0, 0}, {0, .5f, 0});
    } else if (kind == 3) {
        path.path = graphics::PathSystem::polygon(
            {{1, -.5f, 0}, {2.4f, -.4f, 0}, {2.1f, .6f, 0}, {1.4f, .8f, 0}, {.9f, .2f, 0}});
    } else if (kind == 4) {
        path.path = [center](double u) {
            const double angle = u * 6.283185307179586;

            return center +
                   glm::vec3(float(.7 * std::sin(2 * angle)), float(.6 * std::sin(angle)), float(.3 * std::cos(angle)));
        };
        path.interpolation = graphics::PathSystem::smoothStep;
    } else if (kind == 5) {
        path.path = graphics::PathSystem::circle(center, .65f, {0, 0, 1});
    } else if (kind == 6) {
        path.path = graphics::PathSystem::polyline({{1, -.5f, 0}, {2.4f, -.5f, 0}, {2, .6f, 0}});
        path.playback = graphics::Playback::PingPong;
    } else {
        return false;
    }

    graphics::Motion motion;
    auto& motions = app_.getScene().getMotions();

    if (!pathId_ || !motion.append(graphics::Motion::followPath(path))) {
        return false;
    }

    if (!motions.setMotion(*pathId_, motion) || !motions.seekMotion(*pathId_, 0)) {
        return false;
    }
    std::cout << "경로 " << kind << ": 시작 시각 0초로 변경\n";

    return true;
}

/// 장면 객체와 초기 상태를 구성한다.
bool Console::initScene() {
    demo_ = Demo::Motion;

    auto& scene = app_.getScene();

    scene.clear();
    paused_ = false;
    spinEnabled_ = true;
    globalEnabled_ = false;
    reflection_ = 1;
    insertedLayer_.reset();

    const auto first = scene.addCuboid({.4f, .6f, .3f}, {0, 0, 0});
    const auto second = scene.addCuboid({.4f, .6f, .3f}, {0, 0, 0});

    if (!first || !second) {
        return false;
    }

    if (!scene.setTint(*first, {1, .35f, .2f}) || !scene.setTint(*second, {.2f, .7f, 1})) {
        return false;
    }

    auto& motions = scene.getMotions();

    pathId_ = motions.createMotion(graphics::Motion{});

    graphics::RotationMotion spin;

    spin.degreesPerSecond = 90;
    spinId_ = motions.createSpin(spin);

    graphics::RotationMotion global;

    global.degreesPerSecond = 15;
    globalId_ = motions.createOrbit(global);

    if (!pathId_ || !spinId_ || !globalId_ || !choosePath(1)) {
        return false;
    }

    if (!motions.setMotionEnabled(*globalId_, false) ||
        !motions.bindMotion(graphics::MotionSystem::rootLayer(), *globalId_)) {
        return false;
    }

    const auto normalPath = motions.pushLayer(graphics::MotionSystem::rootLayer());
    const auto reflection = graphics::TransformSystem::reflectPlane({0, 0, 0}, {1, 0, 0});

    if (!normalPath || !reflection) {
        return false;
    }

    graphics::LayerConfig mirror;

    mirror.transform = *reflection;
    mirrorLayer_ = motions.pushLayer(graphics::MotionSystem::rootLayer(), mirror);

    if (!mirrorLayer_) {
        return false;
    }

    const auto mirroredPath = motions.pushLayer(*mirrorLayer_);

    normalSpinLayer_ = motions.pushLayer(*normalPath);

    if (!mirroredPath || !normalSpinLayer_) {
        return false;
    }

    const auto mirroredSpin = motions.pushLayer(*mirroredPath);

    if (!mirroredSpin || !motions.bindMotion(*normalPath, *pathId_) || !motions.bindMotion(*mirroredPath, *pathId_) ||
        !motions.bindMotion(*normalSpinLayer_, *spinId_) || !motions.bindMotion(*mirroredSpin, *spinId_) ||
        !scene.bindEntity(*first, *normalSpinLayer_) || !scene.bindEntity(*second, *mirroredSpin)) {
        return false;
    }

    if (!scene.addBasis({0, 0, 0}, glm::mat3(1), {.55f, .55f, .55f}, *first) ||
        !scene.addBasis({0, 0, 0}, glm::mat3(1), {.55f, .55f, .55f}, *second) ||
        !scene.addLine({0, -1.4f, 0}, {0, 1.4f, 0}, {.5f, .5f, .5f})) {
        return false;
    }

    auto& camera = app_.getCamera();

    camera.position = {5, 3, 8};
    camera.target = {0, 0, 0};
    camera.up = {0, 1, 0};
    printHelp();

    return true;
}

/// 반사 변환을 순서대로 변경한다.
bool Console::changeReflection() {
    const int next = (reflection_ + 1) % 4;
    std::optional<glm::mat4> matrix = glm::mat4(1);

    if (next == 1) {
        matrix = graphics::TransformSystem::reflectPlane({0, 0, 0}, {1, 0, 0});
    } else if (next == 2) {
        matrix = graphics::TransformSystem::reflectPoint({0, 0, 0});
    } else if (next == 3) {
        matrix = graphics::TransformSystem::reflectLine(graphics::AxisLine{});
    }

    if (!mirrorLayer_ || !matrix) {
        return false;
    }

    graphics::LayerConfig config;

    config.transform = *matrix;

    if (!app_.getScene().getMotions().setLayer(*mirrorLayer_, config)) {
        return false;
    }
    reflection_ = next;

    const char* names[] = {"없음", "YZ평면 반사", "원점 점대칭", "Y축 직선대칭"};

    std::cout << "반사: " << names[reflection_] << '\n';

    return true;
}

/// 크기 레이어를 삽입하거나 제거한다.
bool Console::toggleInsertedLayer() {
    auto& motions = app_.getScene().getMotions();

    if (insertedLayer_) {
        if (!motions.removeLayer(*insertedLayer_)) {
            return false;
        }
        insertedLayer_.reset();
        std::cout << "추가 크기 레이어 삭제\n";

        return true;
    }

    const auto scale = graphics::TransformSystem::scaling(glm::vec3(1.5f));

    if (!normalSpinLayer_ || !scale) {
        return false;
    }

    graphics::LayerConfig config;

    config.space = graphics::TransformSpace::Local;
    config.transform = *scale;
    insertedLayer_ = motions.insertLayer(*normalSpinLayer_, config);

    if (!insertedLayer_) {
        return false;
    }
    std::cout << "첫 객체에 1.5배 Local 크기 레이어 삽입\n";

    return true;
}

/// 키 입력에 따라 동작을 변경한다.
void Console::onKey(int key, int action) {
    if (action != GLFW_PRESS) {
        return;
    }

    if (key == GLFW_KEY_7 || key == GLFW_KEY_8 || key == GLFW_KEY_9 || key == GLFW_KEY_0) {
        const bool ok = key == GLFW_KEY_7   ? initGrid()
                        : key == GLFW_KEY_8 ? initRoom()
                        : key == GLFW_KEY_9 ? initAnimation()
                                            : initScene();

        if (!ok)
            app_.requestClose();

        return;
    }

    if (key == GLFW_KEY_V) {
        threeViews_ = !threeViews_;

        return;
    }

    if (key == GLFW_KEY_D) {
        trace_ = !trace_;
        graphics::Diagnostics::configure({true, trace_});

        return;
    }

    if (demo_ == Demo::Animation && handleJointKey(key))
        return;

    if (key == GLFW_KEY_F && demo_ == Demo::Room) {
        floorOpen_ = !floorOpen_;

        return;
    }

    if (demo_ != Demo::Motion) {
        if (key == GLFW_KEY_SPACE)
            clock_.playing = !clock_.playing;
        else if (key == GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE)
            app_.requestClose();
        else if (key == GLFW_KEY_H)
            printHelp();

        return;
    }

    auto& motions = app_.getScene().getMotions();
    bool ok = true;

    if (key == GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE) {
        app_.requestClose();
    } else if (key >= GLFW_KEY_1 && key <= GLFW_KEY_6) {
        ok = choosePath(key - GLFW_KEY_1 + 1);
    } else if (key == GLFW_KEY_SPACE) {
        const bool playing = paused_;

        ok = pathId_ && spinId_ && globalId_ && motions.setMotionPlaying(*pathId_, playing) &&
             motions.setMotionPlaying(*spinId_, playing) && motions.setMotionPlaying(*globalId_, playing);

        if (ok) {
            paused_ = !paused_;
            std::cout << (paused_ ? "시간 정지\n" : "시간 재개\n");
        }
    } else if (key == GLFW_KEY_S) {
        ok = spinId_ && motions.setMotionEnabled(*spinId_, !spinEnabled_);

        if (ok) {
            spinEnabled_ = !spinEnabled_;
            std::cout << "자전 기여: " << spinEnabled_ << '\n';
        }
    } else if (key == GLFW_KEY_G) {
        ok = globalId_ && motions.setMotionEnabled(*globalId_, !globalEnabled_);

        if (ok) {
            globalEnabled_ = !globalEnabled_;
            std::cout << "전체 공전 기여: " << globalEnabled_ << '\n';
        }
    } else if (key == GLFW_KEY_M) {
        ok = changeReflection();
    } else if (key == GLFW_KEY_I) {
        ok = toggleInsertedLayer();
    } else if (key == GLFW_KEY_H) {
        printHelp();
    }

    if (!ok) {
        std::cerr << "샘플 명령 적용 실패. 장면을 종료합니다.\n";
        app_.requestClose();
    }
}

/// 마우스 버튼 입력을 처리한다.
void Console::onMouse(const graphics::MouseEvent& event) {
    if (event.button != GLFW_MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT || event.action != GLFW_PRESS) {
        return;
    }

    std::optional<graphics::PickResult> hit;

    if (threeViews_) {
        const auto size = app_.getFramebufferSize();

        if (size[0] < 3 || size[1] < 2)
            return;

        const auto passes =
            graphics::PatternSystem::threeViews(app_.getCamera(), size[0], size[1], app_.getRenderOptions());

        for (const auto& pass : passes) {
            const auto& v = pass.viewport;
            const double top = size[1] - v.y - v.height;

            if (event.framebufferX >= v.x && event.framebufferX < v.x + v.width && event.framebufferY >= top &&
                event.framebufferY < top + v.height)
                hit = graphics::pick(app_.getScene(), pass.camera, event.framebufferX, event.framebufferY,
                                     {double(v.x), top, double(v.width), double(v.height)});
        }
    } else
        hit = app_.pickAt(event.windowX, event.windowY);

    if (hit) {
        std::cout << "entity=" << hit->entityId << " face=" << hit->faceIndex << '\n';
    }
}

/// 조작 방법을 출력한다.
void Console::printHelp() const {
    std::cout
        << "standard: 프레임워크 Motion·반사·레이어 샘플\n"
        << "1 타원 / 2 사각형 / 3 다각형 / 4 사용자 3D 경로+보간 / 5 원 / 6 왕복 꺾은선\n"
        << "Space 시간 정지·재개 / S 자전 기여 / G 전체 공전 기여\n"
        << "M 반사 변경 / I 크기 레이어 삽입·삭제 / H 도움말 / Esc 종료\n"
        << "초기 반사: YZ평면. M은 점대칭 -> Y축 직선대칭 -> 없음 -> YZ평면 순환\n"
        << "왼쪽 클릭: 물체의 entity/face ID 출력\n"
        << "7 Grid/거리 기반 배치 / 8 실내 미끄럼·낙하 / 0 기존 Motion 예제\n"
        << "9 선형보간·진자·사람형·그네→사람 계층 애니메이션\n"
        << "9번 관절: Tab/Backspace 선택, X/Y/Z 축, 좌우 회전, 상하 이동, PageUp/Down 피벗, +/- 균일 배율, R 복원\n"
        << "V 3뷰 전환 / D 단계 추적 로그 / F 실내 예제 바닥 개방 / Space 정지·재개\n";
}

/// 거리 기반 격자 예제를 구성한다.
bool Console::initGrid() {
    auto& scene = app_.getScene();

    scene.clear();
    demo_ = Demo::Grid;
    clock_.reset();
    gridBoxes_.clear();

    graphics::GridLayout grid;

    grid.origin = {-3, -.1f, -2};
    grid.extent = {6, .2f, 4};
    grid.cells = {6, 1, 4};

    for (int z = 0; z < 4; ++z)
        for (int x = 0; x < 6; ++x) {
            const auto center = grid.cellCenter({x, 0, z}), size = grid.relativeSize({.15f, 1, .22f});

            if (!center || !size ||
                !graphics::PatternSystem::addBox(scene, *size, *center,
                                                 (x + z) % 2 ? graphics::GlColor{.25f, .3f, .4f}
                                                             : graphics::GlColor{.4f, .45f, .55f}))
                return false;
        }

    if (!distancePath_.setPoints({{-2.5f, .35f, -1.5f}, {2.5f, .35f, -1.5f}, {2.5f, .35f, 1.5f}}))
        return false;

    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
        const auto box =
            graphics::PatternSystem::addBox(scene, {.4f, .5f, .4f}, {0, 0, 0}, {.25f + .14f * i, .7f - .1f * i, .3f});

        if (!box || !graphics::PatternSystem::addNumber(scene, i + 1, {-.07f, -.1f, .205f}, .2f, {1, 1, 1}, *box))
            return false;
        gridBoxes_.push_back(*box);
    }
    app_.getCamera() = graphics::Camera{};
    app_.getCamera().position = {7, 6, 8};
    app_.getCamera().target = {0, 0, 0};
    app_.getCamera().orthographicHalfExtent = 4;

    return true;
}

/// 회전하는 방 예제를 구성한다.
bool Console::initRoom() {
    auto& scene = app_.getScene();

    scene.clear();
    demo_ = Demo::Room;
    clock_.reset();
    floorOpen_ = false;

    const auto room = graphics::PatternSystem::addRoom(scene, {{-2, -1, -2}, {2, 2, 2}});
    const auto cube = graphics::PatternSystem::addBox(scene, {.5f, .5f, .5f}, {0, -.75f, 0}, {1, .7f, .2f});

    if (!room || !cube)
        return false;
    room_ = *room;
    roomCube_ = *cube;
    roomBody_ = graphics::RoomBody{};
    roomBody_.localPosition = {0, -.75f, 0};
    roomBody_.halfExtent = {.25f, .25f, .25f};
    app_.getCamera() = graphics::Camera{};
    app_.getCamera().position = {5, 3, 8};
    app_.getCamera().target = {0, 0, 0};

    return true;
}

/// 선형보간과 그네·사람의 부모·자식 애니메이션을 구성한다.
bool Console::initAnimation() {
    auto& scene = app_.getScene();

    scene.clear();
    demo_ = Demo::Animation;
    clock_.reset();
    animation_.clear();
    jointControls_.clear();
    selectedJoint_ = 0;
    selectedAxis_ = 0;
