#include "Console.h"
#include <iostream>

/// 선택한 경로로 이동 모션을 바꾼다.
bool Console::choosePath(int kind) {
    graphics::PathMotion path;

    path.durationSeconds = 6;

    const glm::vec3 center(1.7f, 0, 0);

    if (kind == 1) {
        path.path = graphics::PathSystem::ellipse(center, {.8f, 0, 0}, {0, .5f, 0});
    } else if (kind == 2) {
        path.path = graphics::PathSystem::rectangle(center, {.8f, 0, 0}, {0, .5f, 0});
    } else if (kind == 3) {
        path.path = graphics::PathSystem::polygon(
            {{1, -.5f, 0}, {2.4f, -.4f, 0}, {2.1f, .6f, 0}, {1.4f, .8f, 0}, {.9f, .2f, 0}});
    } else if (kind == 4) {
        path.path = [center](double u) {
            const double angle = u * 6.283185307179586;

            return center +
                   glm::vec3(float(.7 * std::sin(2 * angle)), float(.6 * std::sin(angle)), float(.3 * std::cos(angle)));
        };
        path.interpolation = graphics::PathSystem::smoothStep;
    } else if (kind == 5) {
        path.path = graphics::PathSystem::circle(center, .65f, {0, 0, 1});
    } else if (kind == 6) {
        path.path = graphics::PathSystem::polyline({{1, -.5f, 0}, {2.4f, -.5f, 0}, {2, .6f, 0}});
        path.playback = graphics::Playback::PingPong;
    } else {
        return false;
    }

    graphics::Motion motion;
    auto& motions = app_.getScene().getMotions();

    if (!pathId_ || !motion.append(graphics::Motion::followPath(path))) {
        return false;
    }

    if (!motions.setMotion(*pathId_, motion) || !motions.seekMotion(*pathId_, 0)) {
        return false;
    }
    std::cout << "경로 " << kind << ": 시작 시각 0초로 변경\n";

    return true;
}

/// 장면 객체와 초기 상태를 구성한다.
bool Console::initScene() {
    demo_ = Demo::Motion;

    auto& scene = app_.getScene();

    scene.clear();
    paused_ = false;
    spinEnabled_ = true;
    globalEnabled_ = false;
    reflection_ = 1;
    insertedLayer_.reset();

    const auto first = scene.addCuboid({.4f, .6f, .3f}, {0, 0, 0});
    const auto second = scene.addCuboid({.4f, .6f, .3f}, {0, 0, 0});

    if (!first || !second) {
        return false;
    }

    if (!scene.setTint(*first, {1, .35f, .2f}) || !scene.setTint(*second, {.2f, .7f, 1})) {
        return false;
    }

    auto& motions = scene.getMotions();

    pathId_ = motions.createMotion(graphics::Motion{});

    graphics::RotationMotion spin;

    spin.degreesPerSecond = 90;
    spinId_ = motions.createSpin(spin);

    graphics::RotationMotion global;

    global.degreesPerSecond = 15;
    globalId_ = motions.createOrbit(global);

    if (!pathId_ || !spinId_ || !globalId_ || !choosePath(1)) {
        return false;
    }

    if (!motions.setMotionEnabled(*globalId_, false) ||
        !motions.bindMotion(graphics::MotionSystem::rootLayer(), *globalId_)) {
        return false;
    }

    const auto normalPath = motions.pushLayer(graphics::MotionSystem::rootLayer());
    const auto reflection = graphics::TransformSystem::reflectPlane({0, 0, 0}, {1, 0, 0});

    if (!normalPath || !reflection) {
        return false;
    }

    graphics::LayerConfig mirror;

    mirror.transform = *reflection;
    mirrorLayer_ = motions.pushLayer(graphics::MotionSystem::rootLayer(), mirror);

    if (!mirrorLayer_) {
        return false;
    }

    const auto mirroredPath = motions.pushLayer(*mirrorLayer_);

    normalSpinLayer_ = motions.pushLayer(*normalPath);

    if (!mirroredPath || !normalSpinLayer_) {
        return false;
    }

    const auto mirroredSpin = motions.pushLayer(*mirroredPath);

    if (!mirroredSpin || !motions.bindMotion(*normalPath, *pathId_) || !motions.bindMotion(*mirroredPath, *pathId_) ||
        !motions.bindMotion(*normalSpinLayer_, *spinId_) || !motions.bindMotion(*mirroredSpin, *spinId_) ||
        !scene.bindEntity(*first, *normalSpinLayer_) || !scene.bindEntity(*second, *mirroredSpin)) {
        return false;
    }

    if (!scene.addBasis({0, 0, 0}, glm::mat3(1), {.55f, .55f, .55f}, *first) ||
        !scene.addBasis({0, 0, 0}, glm::mat3(1), {.55f, .55f, .55f}, *second) ||
        !scene.addLine({0, -1.4f, 0}, {0, 1.4f, 0}, {.5f, .5f, .5f})) {
        return false;
    }

    auto& camera = app_.getCamera();

    camera.position = {5, 3, 8};
    camera.target = {0, 0, 0};
    camera.up = {0, 1, 0};
    printHelp();

    return true;
}

/// 반사 변환을 순서대로 변경한다.
bool Console::changeReflection() {
    const int next = (reflection_ + 1) % 4;
    std::optional<glm::mat4> matrix = glm::mat4(1);

    if (next == 1) {
        matrix = graphics::TransformSystem::reflectPlane({0, 0, 0}, {1, 0, 0});
    } else if (next == 2) {
        matrix = graphics::TransformSystem::reflectPoint({0, 0, 0});
    } else if (next == 3) {
        matrix = graphics::TransformSystem::reflectLine(graphics::AxisLine{});
    }

    if (!mirrorLayer_ || !matrix) {
        return false;
    }

    graphics::LayerConfig config;

    config.transform = *matrix;

    if (!app_.getScene().getMotions().setLayer(*mirrorLayer_, config)) {
        return false;
    }
    reflection_ = next;

    const char* names[] = {"없음", "YZ평면 반사", "원점 점대칭", "Y축 직선대칭"};

    std::cout << "반사: " << names[reflection_] << '\n';

    return true;
}

/// 크기 레이어를 삽입하거나 제거한다.
bool Console::toggleInsertedLayer() {
    auto& motions = app_.getScene().getMotions();

    if (insertedLayer_) {
        if (!motions.removeLayer(*insertedLayer_)) {
            return false;
        }
        insertedLayer_.reset();
        std::cout << "추가 크기 레이어 삭제\n";

        return true;
    }

    const auto scale = graphics::TransformSystem::scaling(glm::vec3(1.5f));

    if (!normalSpinLayer_ || !scale) {
        return false;
    }

    graphics::LayerConfig config;

    config.space = graphics::TransformSpace::Local;
    config.transform = *scale;
    insertedLayer_ = motions.insertLayer(*normalSpinLayer_, config);

    if (!insertedLayer_) {
        return false;
    }
    std::cout << "첫 객체에 1.5배 Local 크기 레이어 삽입\n";

    return true;
}

/// 키 입력에 따라 동작을 변경한다.
void Console::onKey(int key, int action) {
    if (action != GLFW_PRESS) {
        return;
    }

    if (key == GLFW_KEY_7 || key == GLFW_KEY_8 || key == GLFW_KEY_9 || key == GLFW_KEY_0) {
        const bool ok = key == GLFW_KEY_7   ? initGrid()
                        : key == GLFW_KEY_8 ? initRoom()
                        : key == GLFW_KEY_9 ? initAnimation()
                                            : initScene();

        if (!ok)
            app_.requestClose();

        return;
    }

    if (key == GLFW_KEY_V) {
        threeViews_ = !threeViews_;

        return;
    }

    if (key == GLFW_KEY_D) {
        trace_ = !trace_;
        graphics::Diagnostics::configure({true, trace_});

        return;
    }

    if (demo_ == Demo::Animation && handleJointKey(key))
        return;

    if (key == GLFW_KEY_F && demo_ == Demo::Room) {
        floorOpen_ = !floorOpen_;

        return;
    }

    if (demo_ != Demo::Motion) {
        if (key == GLFW_KEY_SPACE)
            clock_.playing = !clock_.playing;
        else if (key == GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE)
            app_.requestClose();
        else if (key == GLFW_KEY_H)
            printHelp();

        return;
    }

    auto& motions = app_.getScene().getMotions();
    bool ok = true;

    if (key == GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE) {
        app_.requestClose();
    } else if (key >= GLFW_KEY_1 && key <= GLFW_KEY_6) {
        ok = choosePath(key - GLFW_KEY_1 + 1);
    } else if (key == GLFW_KEY_SPACE) {
        const bool playing = paused_;

        ok = pathId_ && spinId_ && globalId_ && motions.setMotionPlaying(*pathId_, playing) &&
             motions.setMotionPlaying(*spinId_, playing) && motions.setMotionPlaying(*globalId_, playing);

        if (ok) {
            paused_ = !paused_;
            std::cout << (paused_ ? "시간 정지\n" : "시간 재개\n");
        }
    } else if (key == GLFW_KEY_S) {
        ok = spinId_ && motions.setMotionEnabled(*spinId_, !spinEnabled_);

        if (ok) {
            spinEnabled_ = !spinEnabled_;
            std::cout << "자전 기여: " << spinEnabled_ << '\n';
        }
    } else if (key == GLFW_KEY_G) {
        ok = globalId_ && motions.setMotionEnabled(*globalId_, !globalEnabled_);

        if (ok) {
            globalEnabled_ = !globalEnabled_;
            std::cout << "전체 공전 기여: " << globalEnabled_ << '\n';
        }
    } else if (key == GLFW_KEY_M) {
        ok = changeReflection();
    } else if (key == GLFW_KEY_I) {
        ok = toggleInsertedLayer();
    } else if (key == GLFW_KEY_H) {
        printHelp();
    }

    if (!ok) {
        std::cerr << "샘플 명령 적용 실패. 장면을 종료합니다.\n";
        app_.requestClose();
    }
}

/// 마우스 버튼 입력을 처리한다.
void Console::onMouse(const graphics::MouseEvent& event) {
    if (event.button != GLFW_MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT || event.action != GLFW_PRESS) {
        return;
    }

    std::optional<graphics::PickResult> hit;

    if (threeViews_) {
        const auto size = app_.getFramebufferSize();

        if (size[0] < 3 || size[1] < 2)
            return;

        const auto passes =
            graphics::PatternSystem::threeViews(app_.getCamera(), size[0], size[1], app_.getRenderOptions());

        for (const auto& pass : passes) {
            const auto& v = pass.viewport;
            const double top = size[1] - v.y - v.height;

            if (event.framebufferX >= v.x && event.framebufferX < v.x + v.width && event.framebufferY >= top &&
                event.framebufferY < top + v.height)
                hit = graphics::pick(app_.getScene(), pass.camera, event.framebufferX, event.framebufferY,
                                     {double(v.x), top, double(v.width), double(v.height)});
        }
    } else
        hit = app_.pickAt(event.windowX, event.windowY);

    if (hit) {
        std::cout << "entity=" << hit->entityId << " face=" << hit->faceIndex << '\n';
    }
}

/// 조작 방법을 출력한다.
void Console::printHelp() const {
    std::cout
        << "standard: 프레임워크 Motion·반사·레이어 샘플\n"
        << "1 타원 / 2 사각형 / 3 다각형 / 4 사용자 3D 경로+보간 / 5 원 / 6 왕복 꺾은선\n"
        << "Space 시간 정지·재개 / S 자전 기여 / G 전체 공전 기여\n"
        << "M 반사 변경 / I 크기 레이어 삽입·삭제 / H 도움말 / Esc 종료\n"
        << "초기 반사: YZ평면. M은 점대칭 -> Y축 직선대칭 -> 없음 -> YZ평면 순환\n"
        << "왼쪽 클릭: 물체의 entity/face ID 출력\n"
        << "7 Grid/거리 기반 배치 / 8 실내 미끄럼·낙하 / 0 기존 Motion 예제\n"
        << "9 선형보간·진자·사람형·그네→사람 계층 애니메이션\n"
        << "9번 관절: Tab/Backspace 선택, X/Y/Z 축, 좌우 회전, 상하 이동, PageUp/Down 피벗, +/- 균일 배율, R 복원\n"
        << "V 3뷰 전환 / D 단계 추적 로그 / F 실내 예제 바닥 개방 / Space 정지·재개\n";
}

/// 거리 기반 격자 예제를 구성한다.
bool Console::initGrid() {
    auto& scene = app_.getScene();

    scene.clear();
    demo_ = Demo::Grid;
    clock_.reset();
    gridBoxes_.clear();

    graphics::GridLayout grid;

    grid.origin = {-3, -.1f, -2};
    grid.extent = {6, .2f, 4};
    grid.cells = {6, 1, 4};

    for (int z = 0; z < 4; ++z)
        for (int x = 0; x < 6; ++x) {
            const auto center = grid.cellCenter({x, 0, z}), size = grid.relativeSize({.15f, 1, .22f});

            if (!center || !size ||
                !graphics::PatternSystem::addBox(scene, *size, *center,
                                                 (x + z) % 2 ? graphics::GlColor{.25f, .3f, .4f}
                                                             : graphics::GlColor{.4f, .45f, .55f}))
                return false;
        }

    if (!distancePath_.setPoints({{-2.5f, .35f, -1.5f}, {2.5f, .35f, -1.5f}, {2.5f, .35f, 1.5f}}))
        return false;

    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
        const auto box =
            graphics::PatternSystem::addBox(scene, {.4f, .5f, .4f}, {0, 0, 0}, {.25f + .14f * i, .7f - .1f * i, .3f});

        if (!box || !graphics::PatternSystem::addNumber(scene, i + 1, {-.07f, -.1f, .205f}, .2f, {1, 1, 1}, *box))
            return false;
        gridBoxes_.push_back(*box);
    }
    app_.getCamera() = graphics::Camera{};
    app_.getCamera().position = {7, 6, 8};
    app_.getCamera().target = {0, 0, 0};
    app_.getCamera().orthographicHalfExtent = 4;

    return true;
}

/// 회전하는 방 예제를 구성한다.
bool Console::initRoom() {
    auto& scene = app_.getScene();

    scene.clear();
    demo_ = Demo::Room;
    clock_.reset();
    floorOpen_ = false;

    const auto room = graphics::PatternSystem::addRoom(scene, {{-2, -1, -2}, {2, 2, 2}});
    const auto cube = graphics::PatternSystem::addBox(scene, {.5f, .5f, .5f}, {0, -.75f, 0}, {1, .7f, .2f});

    if (!room || !cube)
        return false;
    room_ = *room;
    roomCube_ = *cube;
    roomBody_ = graphics::RoomBody{};
    roomBody_.localPosition = {0, -.75f, 0};
    roomBody_.halfExtent = {.25f, .25f, .25f};
    app_.getCamera() = graphics::Camera{};
    app_.getCamera().position = {5, 3, 8};
    app_.getCamera().target = {0, 0, 0};

    return true;
}

/// 선형보간과 그네·사람의 부모·자식 애니메이션을 구성한다.
bool Console::initAnimation() {
    auto& scene = app_.getScene();

    scene.clear();
    demo_ = Demo::Animation;
    clock_.reset();
    animation_.clear();
    jointControls_.clear();
    selectedJoint_ = 0;
    selectedAxis_ = 0;

    if (!graphics::PatternSystem::addBox(scene, {8, .15f, 6}, {0, -.15f, 0}, {.25f, .3f, .35f}))
        return false;

    graphics::SwingConfig swingConfig;

    swingConfig.pivot = {1, 3, 0};
    swingConfig.pendulum.amplitudeDegrees = 25;
    swingConfig.pendulum.periodSeconds = 3;

    const auto swing = graphics::AnimationSystem::addSwingWithRider(scene, swingConfig);

    if (!swing)
        return false;
    animation_ = swing->animation;

    graphics::HumanoidConfig personConfig;

    personConfig.grid.frame = glm::translate(glm::mat4(1), glm::vec3(-2, 0, 0));

    const auto person = graphics::AnimationSystem::addHumanoid(scene, personConfig);

    if (!person)
        return false;

    auto pose = graphics::HumanoidPose::seated();

    pose.hips = {glm::vec3(0), glm::vec3(0)};
    pose.knees = {glm::vec3(0), glm::vec3(0)};

    if (!graphics::AnimationSystem::poseHumanoid(scene, *person, pose))
        return false;

    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
        graphics::PendulumMotion sway;

        sway.amplitudeDegrees = 30;
        sway.periodSeconds = 2;
        sway.phaseDegrees = i == 0 ? 0 : 180;

        graphics::Motion motion;

        if (!motion.append(graphics::Motion::pendulum(sway)))
            return false;

        const auto track = graphics::AnimationSystem::createJointAnimation(scene, person->shoulders[i], motion);

        if (!track)
            return false;
        animation_.push_back(*track);
    }

    const auto marker = scene.addGroup();

    if (!marker || !graphics::PatternSystem::addBox(scene, {.4f, .4f, .4f}, {0, 0, 0}, {1, .85f, .15f}, *marker))
        return false;

    graphics::LinearMotion move;

    move.from = {-2, .3f, 2};
    move.to = {2, .3f, 2};
    move.durationSeconds = 4;
    move.playback = graphics::Playback::PingPong;

    graphics::Motion motion;

    if (!motion.append(graphics::Motion::linear(move)))
        return false;

    const auto track = graphics::AnimationSystem::createJointAnimation(scene, *marker, motion);

    if (!track)
        return false;
    animation_.push_back(*track);

    const auto control = [&](graphics::EntityId id, const std::string& name) {
        std::size_t index = 0;

        while (index < animation_.size() && animation_[index].joint != id)
            ++index;

        if (index == animation_.size()) {
            auto fixed = graphics::AnimationSystem::createJointAnimation(scene, id, graphics::Motion{});

            if (!fixed)
                return false;
            animation_.push_back(*fixed);
        }
        jointControls_.push_back({index, name, animation_[index].rest});

        return true;
    };

    const auto personControls = [&](const graphics::HumanoidRig& rig, const std::string& prefix) {
        if (!control(rig.root, prefix + " root") || !control(rig.pelvis, prefix + " pelvis") ||
            !control(rig.torso, prefix + " torso") || !control(rig.neck, prefix + " neck"))
            return false;

        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
            const auto side = prefix + (i == 0 ? " left " : " right ");

            if (!control(rig.shoulders[i], side + "shoulder") || !control(rig.elbows[i], side + "elbow") ||
                !control(rig.hands[i], side + "hand") || !control(rig.hips[i], side + "hip") ||
                !control(rig.knees[i], side + "knee") || !control(rig.feet[i], side + "foot"))
                return false;
        }

        return true;
    };

    if (!control(swing->frame, "swing frame") || !control(swing->hinge, "swing hinge") ||
        !control(swing->seat, "swing seat") || !personControls(swing->person, "rider") ||
        !personControls(*person, "standing"))
        return false;
    app_.getCamera() = graphics::Camera{};
    app_.getCamera().position = {8, 5, 10};
    app_.getCamera().target = {0, 1.4f, 0};
    std::cout << "9: 노란 상자는 4초 편도 선형보간, 그네는 3초 주기 진자, 좌석의 사람은 계층 변환을 따릅니다.\n";
    printSelectedJoint();

    return graphics::AnimationSystem::poseHierarchy(scene, animation_, 0);
}

/// 선택한 관절의 기준 자세를 편집하고 같은 시각의 애니메이션에 반영한다.
bool Console::handleJointKey(int key) {
    if (jointControls_.empty())
        return false;

    if (key == GLFW_KEY_TAB)
        selectedJoint_ = (selectedJoint_ + 1) % jointControls_.size();
    else if (key == GLFW_KEY_BACKSPACE)
        selectedJoint_ = (selectedJoint_ + jointControls_.size() - 1) % jointControls_.size();
    else if (key == GLFW_KEY_X || key == GLFW_KEY_Y || key == GLFW_KEY_Z)
        selectedAxis_ = key == GLFW_KEY_X ? 0 : key == GLFW_KEY_Y ? 1 : 2;
    else {
        auto& track = animation_[jointControls_[selectedJoint_].track];
        const auto saved = track.rest;

        if (key == GLFW_KEY_LEFT || key == GLFW_KEY_RIGHT) {
            glm::vec3 axis(0);

            axis[selectedAxis_] = 1;
            track.rest.rotation =
                track.rest.rotation *
                glm::mat3(glm::rotate(glm::mat4(1), glm::radians(key == GLFW_KEY_LEFT ? -5.0f : 5.0f), axis));
        } else if (key == GLFW_KEY_UP || key == GLFW_KEY_DOWN)
            track.rest.basis[selectedAxis_] += key == GLFW_KEY_UP ? .05f : -.05f;
        else if (key == GLFW_KEY_PAGE_UP || key == GLFW_KEY_PAGE_DOWN)
            track.rest.localBasis[selectedAxis_] += key == GLFW_KEY_PAGE_UP ? .05f : -.05f;
        else if (key == GLFW_KEY_EQUAL || key == GLFW_KEY_KP_ADD || key == GLFW_KEY_MINUS ||
                 key == GLFW_KEY_KP_SUBTRACT) {
            const bool grow = key == GLFW_KEY_EQUAL || key == GLFW_KEY_KP_ADD;

            track.rest.scale = glm::vec3(std::clamp(track.rest.scale.x * (grow ? 1.1f : 1 / 1.1f), .1f, 3.0f));
        } else if (key == GLFW_KEY_R)
            track.rest = jointControls_[selectedJoint_].initialRest;
        else
            return false;

        if (!graphics::AnimationSystem::poseHierarchy(app_.getScene(), animation_, clock_.seconds)) {
            track.rest = saved;
            std::cerr << "관절 편집 거절: 기준 자세를 복원했습니다.\n";
        }
    }
    printSelectedJoint();

    return true;
}

/// 선택 관절·축·이동·피벗·균일 배율을 출력한다.
void Console::printSelectedJoint() const {
    if (jointControls_.empty())
        return;

    const auto& control = jointControls_[selectedJoint_];
    const auto& rest = animation_[control.track].rest;

    std::cout << "joint " << selectedJoint_ + 1 << '/' << jointControls_.size() << ": " << control.name
              << " axis=" << "XYZ"[selectedAxis_] << " position=" << rest.basis.x << ',' << rest.basis.y << ','
              << rest.basis.z << " pivot=" << rest.localBasis.x << ',' << rest.localBasis.y << ',' << rest.localBasis.z
              << " scale=" << rest.scale.x << '\n';
}

/// 프레임 시간으로 상태와 장면을 갱신한다.
void Console::onUpdate(float dt) {
    if (demo_ == Demo::Motion || !clock_.playing)
        return;

    if (!clock_.advance(dt)) {
        app_.requestClose();

        return;
    }

    auto& scene = app_.getScene();
    bool ok = true;

    if (demo_ == Demo::Animation) {
        ok = graphics::AnimationSystem::poseHierarchy(scene, animation_, clock_.seconds);
    } else if (demo_ == Demo::Grid) {
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < gridBoxes_.size(); ++i)
            ok = graphics::PatternSystem::follow(scene, gridBoxes_[i], distancePath_,
                                                 clock_.seconds + distancePath_.length() * i / 5) &&
                 ok;
    } else {
        const float angle = .4f * float(std::sin(clock_.seconds));
        const auto matrix = glm::rotate(glm::mat4(1), angle, glm::vec3(0, 0, 1));
        graphics::Transform3D roomTransform;

        roomTransform.rotation = glm::mat3(matrix);
        roomTransform.basis = glm::vec3(matrix * glm::vec4(0, .5f, 0, 1));
        ok =
            scene.setTransform(room_, roomTransform) && scene.setFaceVisible(room_, 5, !floorOpen_) &&
            graphics::CollisionSystem::stepRoomBody(roomBody_, {{-2, -1, -2}, {2, 2, 2}}, matrix, dt, floorOpen_, false,
                                                    {0, -9.8f, 0}, {0, 0, .4f * float(std::cos(clock_.seconds))});

        graphics::Transform3D cubeTransform;

        cubeTransform.basis = roomBody_.position(matrix);

        if (!roomBody_.released)
            cubeTransform.rotation = glm::mat3(matrix);
        ok = scene.setTransform(roomCube_, cubeTransform) && ok;
    }

    if (!ok)
        app_.requestClose();
}

/// 현재 장면을 지정한 뷰로 렌더링한다.
bool Console::onRender() {
    if (!threeViews_)
        return app_.renderScene();

    const auto size = app_.getFramebufferSize();

    if (size[0] < 3 || size[1] < 2)
        return true;

    return app_.renderViews(
        graphics::PatternSystem::threeViews(app_.getCamera(), size[0], size[1], app_.getRenderOptions()));
}

#include "../Framework.h"
#include "Internal.h"
#include <set>

namespace graphics {
namespace detail {
bool validJointRest(const Transform3D& rest) {
    return DiagramSystem::validTransform(rest) && rest.scale.x > 1e-6f &&
           std::abs(rest.scale.x - rest.scale.y) < 1e-6f && std::abs(rest.scale.x - rest.scale.z) < 1e-6f;
}
}

HumanoidPose HumanoidPose::seated() {
    HumanoidPose pose;

    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
        pose.hips[i].x = -90;
        pose.knees[i].x = 90;
        pose.shoulders[i].x = -20;
        pose.elbows[i].x = -40;
    }

    return pose;
}

std::optional<JointAnimation> AnimationSystem::createJointAnimation(const Scene& scene, EntityId joint,
                                                                    const Motion& motion) {
    const auto* component = scene.getComponent(joint);
    const auto sample = motion.sample(0);

    if (!component || !sample || !detail::validJointRest(component->transform) || !detail::rigidRoom(sample->parent) ||
        !detail::rigidRoom(sample->local)) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "AnimationSystem::createJointAnimation",
                            "Need a joint with positive uniform rest scale and a rigid motion sample.");

        return {};
    }

    return JointAnimation{joint, component->transform, motion};
}

bool AnimationSystem::poseHierarchy(Scene& scene, const std::vector<JointAnimation>& animation, double seconds) {
    if (!std::isfinite(seconds) || seconds < 0)
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "AnimationSystem::poseHierarchy",
                                   "Need nonnegative finite seconds.");

    std::set<EntityId> seen;
    std::vector<std::pair<EntityId, Transform3D>> staged;

    staged.reserve(animation.size());

    for (const auto& track : animation) {
        const auto sample = track.motion.sample(seconds);
        const auto rest = DiagramSystem::modelMatrix(track.rest);

        if (!scene.getComponent(track.joint) || !seen.insert(track.joint).second || !sample ||
            !detail::validJointRest(track.rest) || !detail::rigidRoom(sample->parent) ||
            !detail::rigidRoom(sample->local))
            return Diagnostics::failAt(
                __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "AnimationSystem::poseHierarchy",
                "Need unique existing joints, positive uniform rest scales and rigid motion samples.");
        // World contributions are in the joint parent's space, before its rest pose.
        const auto matrix = sample->parent * rest * sample->local;
        Transform3D transform;

        transform.basis = glm::vec3(matrix[3]);
        transform.scale = track.rest.scale;
        transform.rotation = glm::mat3(matrix) / track.rest.scale.x;

        if (!DiagramSystem::validTransform(transform))
            return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "AnimationSystem::poseHierarchy",
                                       "Joint composition overflow.");
        staged.emplace_back(track.joint, transform);
    }

    for (const auto& item : staged)
        if (!scene.setTransform(item.first, item.second))
            return false;

    return true;
}

std::optional<HumanoidRig> AnimationSystem::addHumanoid(Scene& scene, const HumanoidConfig& config,
                                                        std::optional<EntityId> parent) {
    if (!config.grid.valid() || !detail::rigidRoom(config.grid.frame) || !std::isfinite(config.upperArmFraction) ||
        config.upperArmFraction <= 0 || config.upperArmFraction >= 1 || !std::isfinite(config.upperLegFraction) ||
        config.upperLegFraction <= 0 || config.upperLegFraction >= 1 || !detail::validColor(config.torsoColor) ||
        !detail::validColor(config.headColor) || !detail::validColor(config.leftColor) ||
        !detail::validColor(config.rightColor) || (parent && !scene.getComponent(*parent))) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Scene, "AnimationSystem::addHumanoid",
                            "Invalid grid, limb fractions, colors or parent.");

        return {};
    }

    Scene staged = scene;
    HumanoidRig rig;
    const auto extent = config.grid.extent;
    Transform3D rootTransform;

    rootTransform.basis = glm::vec3(config.grid.frame[3]);
    rootTransform.rotation = glm::mat3(config.grid.frame);

    const auto root = staged.addGroup(rootTransform);

    if (!root || !staged.setParent(*root, parent))
        return {};
    rig.root = *root;

    const auto pelvis =
        PatternSystem::addJoint(staged, rig.root, config.grid.origin + extent * glm::vec3(.5f, .4f, .5f));

    if (!pelvis)
        return {};
    rig.pelvis = *pelvis;

    const auto torso = PatternSystem::addJoint(staged, rig.pelvis, {0, extent.y * .18f, 0});

    if (!torso)
        return {};
    rig.torso = *torso;

    const auto torsoMesh =
        PatternSystem::addBox(staged, extent * glm::vec3(.45f, .35f, .7f), {0, 0, 0}, config.torsoColor, rig.torso);
    const auto neck = PatternSystem::addJoint(staged, rig.torso, {0, extent.y * .22f, 0});

    if (!torsoMesh || !neck)
        return {};
    rig.torsoMesh = *torsoMesh;
    rig.neck = *neck;

    const auto head = PatternSystem::addBox(staged, extent * glm::vec3(.3f, .2f, .6f), {0, extent.y * .1f, 0},
                                            config.headColor, rig.neck);
    const auto nose = PatternSystem::addBox(staged, extent * glm::vec3(.1f, .05f, .2f),
                                            {0, extent.y * .1f, extent.z * .4f}, {1, .2f, .2f}, rig.neck);

    if (!head || !nose)
        return {};
    rig.head = *head;
    rig.nose = *nose;

    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
        const float side = i == 0 ? -1.0f : 1.0f;
        const auto color = i == 0 ? config.leftColor : config.rightColor;
        const float upperArm = extent.y * .32f * config.upperArmFraction;
        const float forearm = extent.y * .32f - upperArm;
        const float thigh = extent.y * .4f * config.upperLegFraction;
        const float shin = extent.y * .4f - thigh;
        const auto shoulder = PatternSystem::addJoint(staged, rig.torso, {side * extent.x * .3f, extent.y * .14f, 0});
        const auto hip = PatternSystem::addJoint(staged, rig.pelvis, {side * extent.x * .15f, 0, 0});

        if (!shoulder || !hip)
            return {};
        rig.shoulders[i] = *shoulder;
        rig.hips[i] = *hip;

        const auto elbow = PatternSystem::addJoint(staged, *shoulder, {0, -upperArm, 0});
        const auto knee = PatternSystem::addJoint(staged, *hip, {0, -thigh, 0});

        if (!elbow || !knee)
            return {};
        rig.elbows[i] = *elbow;
        rig.knees[i] = *knee;

        const auto hand = PatternSystem::addJoint(staged, *elbow, {0, -forearm, 0});
        const auto foot = PatternSystem::addJoint(staged, *knee, {0, -shin, 0});
        const auto upper = PatternSystem::addBox(staged, {extent.x * .15f, upperArm, extent.z * .3f},
                                                 {0, -upperArm / 2, 0}, color, *shoulder);
        const auto lower = PatternSystem::addBox(staged, {extent.x * .15f, forearm, extent.z * .3f},
                                                 {0, -forearm / 2, 0}, color, *elbow);
        const auto thighMesh =
            PatternSystem::addBox(staged, {extent.x * .18f, thigh, extent.z * .4f}, {0, -thigh / 2, 0}, color, *hip);
        const auto shinMesh =
            PatternSystem::addBox(staged, {extent.x * .18f, shin, extent.z * .4f}, {0, -shin / 2, 0}, color, *knee);

        if (!hand || !foot || !upper || !lower || !thighMesh || !shinMesh)
            return {};
        rig.hands[i] = *hand;
        rig.feet[i] = *foot;
        rig.upperArms[i] = *upper;
        rig.forearms[i] = *lower;
        rig.thighs[i] = *thighMesh;
        rig.shins[i] = *shinMesh;
    }
    scene = std::move(staged);

    return rig;
}

bool AnimationSystem::poseHumanoid(Scene& scene, const HumanoidRig& rig, const HumanoidPose& pose) {
    const std::array<EntityId, 11> joints{rig.pelvis,       rig.torso,     rig.neck,      rig.shoulders[0],
                                          rig.shoulders[1], rig.elbows[0], rig.elbows[1], rig.hips[0],
                                          rig.hips[1],      rig.knees[0],  rig.knees[1]};
    const std::array<glm::vec3, 11> angles{pose.pelvisDegrees, pose.torsoDegrees, pose.neckDegrees, pose.shoulders[0],
                                           pose.shoulders[1],  pose.elbows[0],    pose.elbows[1],   pose.hips[0],
                                           pose.hips[1],       pose.knees[0],     pose.knees[1]};
    std::set<EntityId> seen;
    std::array<Transform3D, 11> transforms;

    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < joints.size(); ++i) {
        const auto* component = scene.getComponent(joints[i]);

        if (!component || !seen.insert(joints[i]).second || !detail::finiteVector(angles[i]))
            return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "AnimationSystem::poseHumanoid",
                                       "Invalid joint or Euler angles.");

        glm::mat4 rotation(1);

        for (int axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis) {
            glm::vec3 direction(0);

            direction[axis] = 1;

            const auto turn = TransformSystem::rotation({{0, 0, 0}, direction}, angles[i][axis]);

            if (!turn)
                return false;
            rotation = *turn * rotation;
        }
        transforms[i] = component->transform;
        transforms[i].rotation = glm::mat3(rotation);

        if (!DiagramSystem::validTransform(transforms[i]))
            return false;
    }

    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < joints.size(); ++i)
        if (!scene.setTransform(joints[i], transforms[i]))
            return false;

    return true;
}

std::optional<SwingRig> AnimationSystem::addSwingWithRider(Scene& scene, const SwingConfig& config,
                                                           std::optional<EntityId> parent) {
    Motion swingMotion;
    auto pendulum = config.pendulum;

    pendulum.axis.point = {0, 0, 0};
    pendulum.space = TransformSpace::Local;

    if (!detail::finiteVector(config.pivot) || !detail::positiveLengths(config.seatSize) ||
        !std::isfinite(config.length) || config.length <= 0 || !std::isfinite(config.ropeThickness) ||
        config.ropeThickness <= 0 || !std::isfinite(config.riderSwayDegrees) || config.riderSwayDegrees < 0 ||
        (parent && !scene.getComponent(*parent)) || !swingMotion.append(Motion::pendulum(pendulum))) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Scene, "AnimationSystem::addSwingWithRider",
                            "Invalid swing configuration or parent.");

        return {};
    }

    Scene staged = scene;
    SwingRig rig;
    Transform3D transform;

    transform.basis = config.pivot;

    const auto frame = staged.addGroup(transform);

    if (!frame || !staged.setParent(*frame, parent))
        return {};
    rig.frame = *frame;

    const auto hinge = PatternSystem::addJoint(staged, rig.frame, {0, 0, 0});

    if (!hinge)
        return {};
    rig.hinge = *hinge;

    const auto seat =
        PatternSystem::addBox(staged, config.seatSize, {0, -config.length, 0}, {.55f, .3f, .1f}, rig.hinge);

    if (!seat)
        return {};
    rig.seat = *seat;

    if (!PatternSystem::addBox(staged, {config.seatSize.x + .6f, .12f, .12f}, {0, 0, 0}, {.3f, .35f, .4f}, rig.frame))
        return {};

    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
        const float side = i == 0 ? -1.0f : 1.0f;
        const auto rope = PatternSystem::addBox(staged, {config.ropeThickness, config.length, config.ropeThickness},
                                                {side * config.seatSize.x * .43f, -config.length / 2, 0},
                                                {.75f, .75f, .75f}, rig.hinge);

        if (!rope || !PatternSystem::addBox(staged, {.12f, config.length + 1, .12f},
                                            {side * (config.seatSize.x / 2 + .2f), -(config.length + 1) / 2, 0},
                                            {.3f, .35f, .4f}, rig.frame))
            return {};
        rig.ropes[i] = *rope;
    }

    const auto person = addHumanoid(staged, config.person, rig.seat);

    if (!person || !poseHumanoid(staged, *person, HumanoidPose::seated()))
        return {};
    rig.person = *person;

    const auto* root = staged.getComponent(rig.person.root);
    auto personTransform = root->transform;
    const auto hipCenter = config.person.grid.origin + config.person.grid.extent * glm::vec3(.5f, .4f, .5f);
    const float thighHalfThickness = config.person.grid.extent.z * .2f;

    personTransform.basis =
        glm::vec3(0, config.seatSize.y / 2 + thighHalfThickness, 0) - personTransform.rotation * hipCenter;

    if (!staged.setTransform(rig.person.root, personTransform))
        return {};

    const auto swingTrack = createJointAnimation(staged, rig.hinge, swingMotion);
    PendulumMotion rider;

    rider.periodSeconds = pendulum.periodSeconds;
    rider.amplitudeDegrees = config.riderSwayDegrees;
    rider.phaseDegrees = std::remainder(pendulum.phaseDegrees, 360.0) + 180;

    Motion riderMotion;

    if (!riderMotion.append(Motion::pendulum(rider)))
        return {};

    const auto riderTrack = createJointAnimation(staged, rig.person.torso, riderMotion);

    if (!swingTrack || !riderTrack)
        return {};
    rig.animation = {*swingTrack, *riderTrack};

    if (!poseHierarchy(staged, rig.animation, 0))
        return {};
    scene = std::move(staged);

    return rig;
}
} // namespace graphics

셰이더 파일의 원문을 읽기

외부 셰이더를 직접 관리하는 도구에서 파일 내용을 읽는다. readTextFile은 문자열을 읽을 뿐 셰이더 컴파일·링크를 수행하지 않는다.

변수·객체 역할. path는 읽을 파일 경로이고 contents는 CPU 문자열이다. 구현은 파일을 열지 못하면 빈 문자열을 반환한다. 따라서 빈 파일과 열기 실패는 이 반환값만으로 구분할 수 없다.

새로 작성한 사용 사례 · 단편별 전제는 본문 참조 · 빌드하지 않음

void showShaderText(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
    auto contents=graphics::readTextFile(path);
    if(contents.empty()) { std::cerr<<"비어 있거나 읽을 수 없는 셰이더 파일"; return; }
    std::cout<<contents;
}

GPU에서 사용하려면 별도의 셰이더 생성·컴파일·링크 단계가 필요하다. 함수는 파일 앞의 UTF-8 BOM을 제거한다. 기본 Application은 경로가 비어 있으면 내장 셰이더를 사용한다.

실제 저장소 소스 · framework/detail/Renderer.cpp
#include "../Framework.h"
#include "Internal.h"
#include "Shaders.h"
#include "../dependencies/glm/glm/gtc/type_ptr.hpp"
#include <algorithm>
#include <fstream>
#include <iostream>
#include <sstream>
#include <cstring>

namespace graphics {
std::string readTextFile(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
    std::ifstream input(path, std::ios::binary);

    if (!input)
        return {};

    std::ostringstream buffer;

    buffer << input.rdbuf();

    auto text = buffer.str();

    if (text.compare(0, 3, "\xEF\xBB\xBF") == 0)
        text.erase(0, 3);

    return text;
}

namespace detail {
GLuint compileShader(GLenum kind, const std::string& sourceText, const std::filesystem::path& sourcePath) {
    Diagnostics::trace(PipelineStage::Shader, "compileShader");

    auto& api = gl();
    const auto shader = api.CreateShader(kind);

    if (!shader) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Shader, "glCreateShader", "Shader allocation failed.");

        return 0;
    }

    const char* text = sourceText.c_str();

    api.ShaderSource(shader, 1, &text, nullptr);
    api.CompileShader(shader);

    GLint success = 0;

    api.GetShaderiv(shader, GL_COMPILE_STATUS, &success);

    if (!success) {
        GLint length = 0;

        api.GetShaderiv(shader, GL_INFO_LOG_LENGTH, &length);

        std::string log(std::max(length, 1), '\0');

        api.GetShaderInfoLog(shader, GLsizei(log.size()), nullptr, log.data());
        Diagnostics::failAt(
            __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Shader, kind == GL_VERTEX_SHADER ? "vertex shader" : "fragment shader",
            "GLSL file=" + sourcePath.u8string() + "\n" + log,
            "Read the compiler line number; check GLSL version, declarations and shader inputs/outputs.");
        api.DeleteShader(shader);

        return 0;
    }

    return shader;
}

bool validLayout(const VertexLayout& layout) {
    if (!layout.stride || layout.stride > std::size_t(std::numeric_limits<GLsizei>::max()) || layout.attributes.empty())
        return false;
    GLint maximum = 0;
    gl().GetIntegerv(GL_MAX_VERTEX_ATTRIBS, &maximum);
    std::vector<GLuint> used;
    for (const auto& a : layout.attributes) {
        std::size_t bytes = 0;
        switch (a.type) {
        case GL_BYTE: case GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE: bytes = 1; break;
        case GL_SHORT: case GL_UNSIGNED_SHORT: bytes = 2; break;
        case GL_INT: case GL_UNSIGNED_INT: case GL_FLOAT: bytes = 4; break;
        default: return false;
        }
        if (a.location >= GLuint(maximum) || a.components < 1 || a.components > 4 ||
            a.offset > layout.stride || std::size_t(a.components)*bytes > layout.stride-a.offset ||
            (a.integer && (a.normalized || a.type == GL_FLOAT)) ||
            std::find(used.begin(), used.end(), a.location) != used.end())
            return false;
        used.push_back(a.location);
    }
    return true;
}

GLuint uploadTexture(const TextureImage& image, bool repeat) {
    auto& api = gl();
    GLuint id = 0;

    api.GenTextures(1, &id);

    if (!id) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Asset, "glGenTextures", "Texture allocation failed.");

        return 0;
    }
    api.ActiveTexture(GL_TEXTURE0);
    api.BindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, id);

    GLint previousAlignment = 4;

    api.GetIntegerv(GL_UNPACK_ALIGNMENT, &previousAlignment);
    api.PixelStorei(GL_UNPACK_ALIGNMENT, 1);
    api.TexImage2D(GL_TEXTURE_2D, 0, GL_RGBA8, GLsizei(image.width), GLsizei(image.height), 0, GL_RGBA,
                   GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, image.rgba.data());
    api.PixelStorei(GL_UNPACK_ALIGNMENT, previousAlignment);
    api.TexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, GL_LINEAR);
    api.TexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, GL_LINEAR);
    api.TexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_S, repeat ? GL_REPEAT : GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
    api.TexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_T, repeat ? GL_REPEAT : GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE);

    if (!checkGlAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Asset, "uploadTexture")) {
        api.DeleteTextures(1, &id);

        return 0;
    }

    return id;
}
} // namespace detail

bool Renderer::initShader(const std::filesystem::path& vertexPath, const std::filesystem::path& fragmentPath) {
    auto& gl = detail::gl();
    const auto vertexText = vertexPath.empty() ? std::string(detail::vertexShader) : readTextFile(vertexPath);
    const auto fragmentText = fragmentPath.empty() ? std::string(detail::fragmentShader) : readTextFile(fragmentPath);

    if (vertexText.empty() || fragmentText.empty())
        return Diagnostics::failAt(
            __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Shader, "Renderer::initShader",
            "Shader source is empty or unreadable: vertex=" + vertexPath.u8string() +
                "; fragment=" + fragmentPath.u8string(),
            "Use embedded shaders (empty shaderDirectory), or copy both GLSL files to the configured project-relative directory.");
    // /utf-8 /FC encodes __FILE__ as UTF-8, not the Windows ANSI code page.
    const auto embeddedSource = std::filesystem::u8path(__FILE__).parent_path() / "Shaders.h";
    const auto vertex =
        detail::compileShader(GL_VERTEX_SHADER, vertexText, vertexPath.empty() ? embeddedSource : vertexPath);

    if (!vertex)
        return false;

    const auto fragment =
        detail::compileShader(GL_FRAGMENT_SHADER, fragmentText, fragmentPath.empty() ? embeddedSource : fragmentPath);

    if (!fragment) {
        gl.DeleteShader(vertex);

        return false;
    }
    shaderProgramID_ = gl.CreateProgram();

    if (!shaderProgramID_) {
        gl.DeleteShader(vertex);
        gl.DeleteShader(fragment);

        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Shader, "glCreateProgram",
                                   "Program allocation failed.");
    }
    gl.AttachShader(shaderProgramID_, vertex);
    gl.AttachShader(shaderProgramID_, fragment);
    gl.LinkProgram(shaderProgramID_);
    gl.DeleteShader(vertex);
    gl.DeleteShader(fragment);

    GLint success = 0;

    gl.GetProgramiv(shaderProgramID_, GL_LINK_STATUS, &success);

    if (!success) {
        GLint size = 0;

        gl.GetProgramiv(shaderProgramID_, GL_INFO_LOG_LENGTH, &size);

        std::string log(std::max(size, 1), '\0');

        gl.GetProgramInfoLog(shaderProgramID_, GLsizei(log.size()), nullptr, log.data());

        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Shader, "glLinkProgram", log,
                                   "Match vertex outputs and fragment inputs; inspect the linker log.");
    }
    mvpLocation_ = gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_, config_.uniforms.mvp.c_str());
    modelLocation_ = gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_, config_.uniforms.model.c_str());
    normalLocation_ = gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_, config_.uniforms.normal.c_str());
    textureLocation_ = gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_, config_.uniforms.texture.c_str());
    hasTextureLocation_ = gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_, config_.uniforms.hasTexture.c_str());
    lightingLocation_ = gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_, config_.uniforms.lighting.c_str());
    lightDirectionLocation_ = gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_, config_.uniforms.lightDirection.c_str());
    lightColorLocation_ = gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_, config_.uniforms.lightColor.c_str());
    overrideLocation_ = gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_, config_.uniforms.overrideColor.c_str());
    outlineColorLocation_ = gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_, config_.uniforms.outlineColor.c_str());
    tintLocation_ = gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_, config_.uniforms.tint.c_str());

    return mvpLocation_ >= 0 || (config_.uniforms.mvp.empty() && bool(config_.bindUniforms)) || Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Shader, "glGetUniformLocation",
                                                    "Required MVP uniform is missing or optimized away: " + config_.uniforms.mvp);
}

bool Renderer::initialize(const std::filesystem::path& vertexPath, const std::filesystem::path& fragmentPath,
                          const RenderConfig& config) {
    detail::gl().load();
    if (!detail::validLayout(config.vertexLayout) ||
        (!config.packVertices && config.vertexLayout.stride != sizeof(RenderVertex)))
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::VertexInput, "Renderer::initialize",
                                   "Invalid layout, or custom stride without a vertex packer.");
    const auto nextConfig = config; // Copy before destroying resources; config may alias current settings.
    destroy();
    config_ = nextConfig;

    if (!initShader(vertexPath, fragmentPath)) {
        destroy();

        return false;
    }

    auto& gl = detail::gl();

    gl.GenVertexArrays(1, &vao_);
    gl.GenBuffers(1, &vbo_);
    gl.GenBuffers(1, &ebo_);

    if (!vao_ || !vbo_ || !ebo_) {
        destroy();

        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::VertexInput, "Renderer::initialize",
                                   "VAO/VBO/EBO allocation failed.");
    }
    gl.BindVertexArray(vao_);
    gl.BindBuffer(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, vbo_);
    gl.BindBuffer(GL_ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, ebo_);
    for (const auto& attribute : config_.vertexLayout.attributes) {
        const auto pointer = reinterpret_cast<const void*>(attribute.offset);
        if (attribute.integer)
            gl.VertexAttribIPointer(attribute.location, attribute.components, attribute.type,
                                    GLsizei(config_.vertexLayout.stride), pointer);
        else
            gl.VertexAttribPointer(attribute.location, attribute.components, attribute.type,
                                   attribute.normalized ? GL_TRUE : GL_FALSE,
                                   GLsizei(config_.vertexLayout.stride), pointer);
        gl.EnableVertexAttribArray(attribute.location);
    }
    gl.BindVertexArray(0);
    gl.BindBuffer(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, 0);

    return detail::checkGlAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::VertexInput, "Renderer::initialize vertex layout");
}

bool Renderer::upload(const Scene& scene, bool textureMode) {
    Diagnostics::trace(PipelineStage::VertexInput, "Renderer::upload");

    std::vector<RenderVertex> vertices;
    std::vector<GLuint> indices;
    std::vector<DrawRange> ranges;
    TextureMap stagedTextures;
    auto& gl = detail::gl();
    auto cleanup = [&]() {
        for (const auto& item : stagedTextures)
            gl.DeleteTextures(1, &item.second);
    };

    try {
        for (auto id : scene.getIds()) {
            const auto* c = scene.getComponent(id);

            if (c && c->transformOnly)
                continue;

            if (!c || !DiagramSystem::validPolyhedron(c->polyhedron)) {
                cleanup();

                return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::VertexInput, "Renderer::upload",
                                           "Missing component or invalid mesh, indices, colors, UVs or normals.",
                                           "Inspect the entity's mesh data before GPU upload.", id);
            }

            for (std::size_t faceIndex = 0; faceIndex < c->polyhedron.faces.size(); ++faceIndex) {
                const auto& face = c->polyhedron.faces[faceIndex];

                if (vertices.size() + face.localVertices.size() > std::numeric_limits<GLuint>::max()) {
                    cleanup();

                    return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::VertexInput, "Renderer::upload",
                                               "Vertex count exceeds the GPU index range.");
                }

                const auto first = GLuint(vertices.size());
                Mesh normals = face;

                if (normals.vertexNormals.empty())
                    recalculateNormals(normals);

                for (std::size_t i = 0; i < face.localVertices.size(); ++i) {
                    const auto p = face.localVertices[i];
                    const auto n = normals.vertexNormals[i];
                    auto color = face.vertexColors.empty() ? face.color : face.vertexColors[i];

                    color.red *= face.material.color.red;
                    color.green *= face.material.color.green;
                    color.blue *= face.material.color.blue;

                    const auto uv = face.texcoords.empty() ? glm::vec2(0) : face.texcoords[i];

                    vertices.push_back(
                        {{p.x, p.y, p.z}, {color.red, color.green, color.blue}, {uv.x, uv.y}, {n.x, n.y, n.z}});
                }

                const auto triangles = detail::triangles(face);
                const auto outline =
                    meshOutline(face, face.outline == OutlineMode::None ? OutlineMode::FeatureEdges : face.outline);

                if (triangles.size() > std::numeric_limits<GLsizei>::max() ||
                    outline.size() > std::numeric_limits<GLsizei>::max()) {
                    cleanup();

                    return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::VertexInput, "Renderer::upload",
                                               "Draw count exceeds GLsizei range.");
                }

                DrawRange range;

                range.entityId = id;
                range.faceIndex = faceIndex;
                range.firstIndex = indices.size();
                range.count = GLsizei(triangles.size());

                for (auto index : triangles)
                    indices.push_back(first + index);
                range.outlineFirstIndex = indices.size();
                range.outlineCount = GLsizei(outline.size());

                for (auto index : outline)
                    indices.push_back(first + index);
                ranges.push_back(range);

                if (textureMode && face.material.useTexture &&
                    stagedTextures.find(face.material.texture) == stagedTextures.end()) {
                    if (!detail::checkGlAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Asset, "before uploadTexture")) {
                        cleanup();

                        return false;
                    }

                    const auto texture = detail::uploadTexture(*face.material.texture, face.material.repeatTexture);

                    if (!texture) {
                        cleanup();

                        return false;
                    }

                    try {
                        stagedTextures.emplace(face.material.texture, texture);
                    } catch (...) {
                        gl.DeleteTextures(1, &texture);
                        throw;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (std::size_t lineIndex = 0; lineIndex < scene.getLines().size(); ++lineIndex) {
            const auto& line = scene.getLines()[lineIndex];

            if (vertices.size() > std::numeric_limits<GLuint>::max() - 2) {
                cleanup();

                return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::VertexInput, "Renderer::upload lines",
                                           "Vertex count exceeds the GPU index range.");
            }

            const auto first = GLuint(vertices.size());

            for (auto p : {line.start, line.end})
                vertices.push_back(
                    {{p.x, p.y, p.z}, {line.color.red, line.color.green, line.color.blue}, {0, 0}, {0, 0, 0}});

            DrawRange range;

            range.lineId = lineIndex;
            range.firstIndex = indices.size();
            range.count = 2;
            ranges.push_back(range);
            indices.insert(indices.end(), {first, first + 1});
        }

        if (vertices.size() > std::size_t(std::numeric_limits<GLsizeiptr>::max()) / config_.vertexLayout.stride ||
            indices.size() > std::size_t(std::numeric_limits<GLsizeiptr>::max()) / sizeof(GLuint)) {
            cleanup();

            return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::VertexInput, "Renderer::upload",
                                       "Buffer byte size exceeds GLsizeiptr range.");
        }

        const auto byteCount = vertices.size() * config_.vertexLayout.stride;
        std::vector<std::uint8_t> packed;
        if (config_.packVertices) {
            if (!config_.packVertices(vertices, packed) || packed.size() != byteCount) {
                cleanup();
                return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::VertexInput, "packVertices",
                                           "Packer failed or byte count does not match vertex count times stride.");
            }
        } else {
            packed.resize(byteCount);
            if (byteCount)
                std::memcpy(packed.data(), vertices.data(), byteCount);
        }

        if (!detail::checkGlAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::VertexInput, "before buffer upload")) {
            cleanup();

            return false;
        }
        gl.BindVertexArray(vao_);
        gl.BindBuffer(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, vbo_);
        gl.BufferData(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, GLsizeiptr(packed.size()),
                      packed.empty() ? nullptr : packed.data(), GL_STATIC_DRAW);
        gl.BindBuffer(GL_ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, ebo_);
        gl.BufferData(GL_ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, GLsizeiptr(indices.size() * sizeof(GLuint)),
                      indices.empty() ? nullptr : indices.data(), GL_STATIC_DRAW);
        gl.BindVertexArray(0);
        gl.BindBuffer(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, 0);

        if (!detail::checkGlAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::VertexInput, "glBufferData")) {
            cleanup();

            return false;
        }

        for (const auto& item : textures_)
            gl.DeleteTextures(1, &item.second);
        textures_ = std::move(stagedTextures);
        drawRanges_ = std::move(ranges);

        return true;
    } catch (...) {
        cleanup();
        throw;
    }
}

bool Renderer::draw(const Scene& scene, const glm::mat4& view, const glm::mat4& projection,
                    const RenderOptions& options) const {
    Diagnostics::trace(PipelineStage::Transform, "Renderer::draw");

    if (!detail::finiteMatrix(view) || !detail::finiteMatrix(projection))
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Transform, "Renderer::draw",
                                   "View or projection matrix contains NaN/Inf.");

    for (const auto& range : drawRanges_) {
        glm::mat4 matrix(1);

        if (range.lineId) {
            const auto world = scene.lineWorldMatrix(*range.lineId);

            if (!world)
                return false;
            matrix = *world;
        } else {
            const auto* c = scene.getComponent(range.entityId);
            const auto world = scene.faceWorldMatrix(range.entityId, range.faceIndex);

            if (!world)
                return false;
            matrix = *world;
        }

        if (!detail::finiteMatrix(matrix) || !detail::finiteMatrix(projection * view * matrix))
            return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Transform, "Renderer::draw",
                                       "World or MVP matrix contains NaN/Inf.",
                                       "Check parent transforms, scales and motion samples.", range.entityId);
    }

    auto& gl = detail::gl();

    gl.UseProgram(shaderProgramID_);
    gl.BindVertexArray(vao_);

    auto cull = [&](const Mesh* face, const glm::mat4& model) {
        const auto mode = face && face->cull != CullMode::Inherit ? face->cull : options.cull;

        gl.FrontFace(glm::determinant(glm::mat3(model)) < 0 ? GL_CW : GL_CCW);

        if (!face || mode == CullMode::None || mode == CullMode::Inherit)
            gl.Disable(GL_CULL_FACE);
        else {
            gl.Enable(GL_CULL_FACE);
            gl.CullFace(mode == CullMode::Front ? GL_FRONT : GL_BACK);
        }
    };
    gl.ActiveTexture(GL_TEXTURE0);
    gl.Uniform1i(textureLocation_, 0);
    gl.Uniform3f(lightDirectionLocation_, options.lightDirection.x, options.lightDirection.y, options.lightDirection.z);
    gl.Uniform3f(lightColorLocation_, options.lightColor.red, options.lightColor.green, options.lightColor.blue);
    gl.Uniform3f(outlineColorLocation_, options.outlineColor.red, options.outlineColor.green,
                 options.outlineColor.blue);

    if (options.wireframe && options.depthTest) {
        // All surfaces write depth first, so a later object's front face hides earlier back edges.
        gl.ColorMask(GL_FALSE, GL_FALSE, GL_FALSE, GL_FALSE);

        for (const auto& range : drawRanges_) {
            if (range.lineId)
                continue;

            const auto* c = scene.getComponent(range.entityId);
            const auto& face = c->polyhedron.faces[range.faceIndex];

            if (!c->visible || !face.visible)
                continue;

            const auto model = *scene.faceWorldMatrix(range.entityId, range.faceIndex);

            cull(&face, model);

            const auto matrix = projection * view * model;

            gl.UniformMatrix4fv(mvpLocation_, 1, GL_FALSE, glm::value_ptr(matrix));
            if (config_.bindUniforms && !config_.bindUniforms(
                    {shaderProgramID_, scene, range.entityId, range.lineId, range.faceIndex, model, view, projection, true}))
                return false;
            gl.DrawElements(GL_TRIANGLES, range.count, GL_UNSIGNED_INT,
                            reinterpret_cast<const void*>(range.firstIndex * sizeof(GLuint)));
        }
        gl.ColorMask(GL_TRUE, GL_TRUE, GL_TRUE, GL_TRUE);
    }

    for (const auto& range : drawRanges_) {
        glm::mat4 model(1);
        const Mesh* face = nullptr;
        GlColor tint;

        if (range.lineId) {
            const auto& line = scene.getLines()[*range.lineId];

            if (line.owner) {
                const auto* owner = scene.getComponent(*line.owner);

                if (!owner || !owner->visible)
                    continue;
            }

            const auto world = scene.lineWorldMatrix(*range.lineId);

            if (!world)
                return false;
            model = *world;
        } else {
            const auto* c = scene.getComponent(range.entityId);

            if (!c || !c->visible)
                continue;
            face = &c->polyhedron.faces[range.faceIndex];

            if (!face->visible)
                continue;
            tint = c->tint;

            const auto world = scene.faceWorldMatrix(range.entityId, range.faceIndex);

            if (!world)
                return false;
            model = *world;
        }

        const auto mvp = projection * view * model;

        cull(face, model);

        const float determinant = glm::determinant(glm::mat3(model));
        const auto normalMatrix = std::isfinite(determinant) && std::abs(determinant) > 1e-12f
                                      ? glm::transpose(glm::inverse(glm::mat3(model)))
                                      : glm::mat3(1);

        gl.UniformMatrix4fv(mvpLocation_, 1, GL_FALSE, glm::value_ptr(mvp));
        gl.UniformMatrix4fv(modelLocation_, 1, GL_FALSE, glm::value_ptr(model));
        gl.UniformMatrix3fv(normalLocation_, 1, GL_FALSE, glm::value_ptr(normalMatrix));
        gl.Uniform3f(tintLocation_, tint.red, tint.green, tint.blue);
        gl.Uniform1i(lightingLocation_, face && options.lighting);
        gl.Uniform1i(overrideLocation_, 0);

        const bool textured = face && options.textures && face->material.useTexture;

        gl.Uniform1i(hasTextureLocation_, textured);

        if (textured) {
            gl.BindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, textures_.at(face->material.texture));
            gl.TexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_S,
                             face->material.repeatTexture ? GL_REPEAT : GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
            gl.TexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_T,
                             face->material.repeatTexture ? GL_REPEAT : GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
        } else
            gl.BindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, 0);

        if (config_.bindUniforms && !config_.bindUniforms(
                {shaderProgramID_, scene, range.lineId ? std::nullopt : std::optional<EntityId>(range.entityId),
                 range.lineId, range.faceIndex, model, view, projection, false}))
            return false;

        if (!face || !options.wireframe) {
            gl.DrawElements(face ? GL_TRIANGLES : GL_LINES, range.count, GL_UNSIGNED_INT,
                            reinterpret_cast<const void*>(range.firstIndex * sizeof(GLuint)));

            if (!detail::checkGlAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Raster, "glDrawElements")) {
                gl.BindVertexArray(0);
                gl.UseProgram(0);

                return false;
            }
        }

        if (face && (options.wireframe || face->outline != OutlineMode::None)) {
            gl.Uniform1i(hasTextureLocation_, 0);
            gl.Uniform1i(lightingLocation_, 0);
            gl.Uniform1i(overrideLocation_, options.wireframe ? 0 : 1);
            gl.DepthFunc(GL_LEQUAL);
            gl.DepthMask(GL_FALSE);
            gl.DrawElements(GL_LINES, range.outlineCount, GL_UNSIGNED_INT,
                            reinterpret_cast<const void*>(range.outlineFirstIndex * sizeof(GLuint)));
            gl.DepthFunc(GL_LESS);
            gl.DepthMask(GL_TRUE);
        }
    }
    gl.Uniform1i(overrideLocation_, 0);
    gl.BindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, 0);
    gl.BindVertexArray(0);
    gl.UseProgram(0);

    return detail::checkGlAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Raster, "Renderer::draw outlines and cleanup");
}

bool Renderer::renderPass(const Scene& scene, const RenderPass& pass, int width, int height) {
    Diagnostics::trace(PipelineStage::Framebuffer, "Renderer::renderPass");

    const auto& camera = pass.camera;
    const auto& options = pass.options;
    const auto& viewport = pass.viewport;

    if (!shaderProgramID_ || !vao_)
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::VertexInput, "Renderer::renderPass",
                                   "Renderer is not initialized.");

    if (width <= 0 || height <= 0)
        return true;

    if (viewport.x < 0 || viewport.y < 0 || viewport.x > width || viewport.y > height || viewport.width < 0 ||
        viewport.height < 0 || viewport.width > width - viewport.x || viewport.height > height - viewport.y)
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Framebuffer, "Renderer::renderPass",
                                   "Viewport lies outside the framebuffer.");

    if (viewport.width == 0 || viewport.height == 0)
        return true;

    if (!CameraSystem::validCamera(camera) || !detail::finiteVector(options.lightDirection) ||
        glm::length(options.lightDirection) < 1e-12f || !detail::validColor(options.lightColor) ||
        !detail::validColor(options.outlineColor) || !std::isfinite(options.background.r) ||
        !std::isfinite(options.background.g) || !std::isfinite(options.background.b) ||
        !std::isfinite(options.background.a) ||
        (options.cull != CullMode::Inherit && options.cull != CullMode::None && options.cull != CullMode::Back &&
         options.cull != CullMode::Front))
        return Diagnostics::failAt(
            __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Transform, "Renderer::renderPass",
            "Invalid camera, light, color or culling mode.",
            "Check near/far planes, FOV, target/up directions, positive orthographic extent and finite render options.");

    if (uploadedScene_ != &scene || uploadedRevision_ != scene.getGeometryRevision() ||
        uploadedTextures_ != options.textures) {
        if (!upload(scene, options.textures))
            return false;
        uploadedScene_ = &scene;
        uploadedRevision_ = scene.getGeometryRevision();
        uploadedTextures_ = options.textures;
    }

    auto& gl = detail::gl();

    if (!detail::checkGlAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Framebuffer, "before Renderer::render"))
        return false;
    gl.Viewport(viewport.x, viewport.y, viewport.width, viewport.height);
    gl.LineWidth(1);

    if (options.depthTest)
        gl.Enable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
    else
        gl.Disable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
    gl.Disable(GL_CULL_FACE);
    gl.Disable(GL_BLEND);
    gl.Enable(GL_SCISSOR_TEST);
    gl.Scissor(viewport.x, viewport.y, viewport.width, viewport.height);
    gl.PolygonMode(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_FILL);
    gl.DepthFunc(GL_LESS);
    gl.DepthMask(GL_TRUE);
    gl.ColorMask(GL_TRUE, GL_TRUE, GL_TRUE, GL_TRUE);
    gl.ClearColor(options.background.r, options.background.g, options.background.b, options.background.a);

    const GLbitfield mask = (pass.clearColor ? GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT : 0) | (pass.clearDepth ? GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT : 0);

    if (mask)
        gl.Clear(mask);

    if (!detail::checkGlAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Framebuffer, "viewport/scissor/clear")) {
        gl.Disable(GL_SCISSOR_TEST);

        return false;
    }

    const bool success = draw(scene, CameraSystem::viewMatrix(camera),
                              CameraSystem::projectionMatrix(camera, float(viewport.width) / viewport.height), options);

    gl.Disable(GL_SCISSOR_TEST);
    gl.Disable(GL_CULL_FACE);
    gl.FrontFace(GL_CCW);

    return success;
}

bool Renderer::render(const Scene& scene, const Camera& camera, int width, int height, const RenderOptions& options) {
    RenderPass pass;

    pass.camera = camera;
    pass.options = options;
    pass.viewport = {0, 0, width, height};

    return renderPass(scene, pass, width, height);
}

bool Renderer::renderViews(const Scene& scene, const std::vector<RenderPass>& passes, int width, int height) {
    if (width <= 0 || height <= 0)
        return true;

    if (passes.empty())
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Framebuffer, "Renderer::renderViews",
                                   "Need at least one render pass.");

    if (!shaderProgramID_ || !vao_)
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::VertexInput, "Renderer::renderViews",
                                   "Renderer is not initialized.");

    auto& gl = detail::gl();

    gl.Disable(GL_SCISSOR_TEST);
    gl.Viewport(0, 0, width, height);
    gl.DepthMask(GL_TRUE);
    gl.ColorMask(GL_TRUE, GL_TRUE, GL_TRUE, GL_TRUE);
    gl.ClearColor(.08f, .08f, .1f, 1);
    gl.Clear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);

    if (!detail::checkGlAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Framebuffer, "Renderer::renderViews full-frame clear"))
        return false;

    for (const auto& pass : passes)
        if (!renderPass(scene, pass, width, height))
            return false;

    return true;
}

void Renderer::destroy() {
    auto& gl = detail::gl();

    if (ebo_)
        gl.DeleteBuffers(1, &ebo_);

    if (vbo_)
        gl.DeleteBuffers(1, &vbo_);

    if (vao_)
        gl.DeleteVertexArrays(1, &vao_);

    if (shaderProgramID_)
        gl.DeleteProgram(shaderProgramID_);

    for (const auto& item : textures_)
        gl.DeleteTextures(1, &item.second);
    textures_.clear();
    drawRanges_.clear();
    ebo_ = vbo_ = vao_ = shaderProgramID_ = 0;
    uploadedScene_ = nullptr;
    uploadedRevision_ = std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max();
    uploadedTextures_ = false;
}
} // namespace graphics

선택한 관절의 SRT·피벗을 애니메이션과 함께 편집하기

그네를 멈추고 왼쪽 팔꿈치만 돌린 뒤 다시 재생한다. Scene 변환을 직접 덮어쓰면 다음 poseHierarchy가 원래 rest로 되돌리므로, 입력은 선택한 트랙의 rest를 수정한다.

변수·객체 역할. selectedTrack은 animation 배열 인덱스이며 EntityId와 다르다. axis는 0/1/2의 X/Y/Z다. basis는 부모 공간 이동, localBasis는 모델 피벗, scale은 양수 균일 배율이다. rest.rotation에 오른쪽으로 회전을 곱하면 선택 관절의 로컬 축을 사용한다.

새로 작성한 사용 사례 · 단편별 전제는 본문 참조 · 빌드하지 않음

bool rotateSelected(graphics::Scene& scene,std::vector<graphics::JointAnimation>& animation,
                    std::size_t selectedTrack,int axis,double seconds) {
    if(selectedTrack>=animation.size()||axis<0||axis>2) return false;
    auto& track=animation[selectedTrack];
    const auto saved=track.rest;
    glm::vec3 direction(0);direction[axis]=1;
    track.rest.rotation=track.rest.rotation*glm::mat3(
        glm::rotate(glm::mat4(1),glm::radians(5.0f),direction));
    if(!graphics::AnimationSystem::poseHierarchy(scene,animation,seconds)) {
        track.rest=saved;return false;
    }
    return true;
}
// 이동 입력: track.rest.basis[axis] += .05f;
// 피벗 입력: track.rest.localBasis[axis] += .05f;
// 배율 입력: track.rest.scale = glm::vec3(1.1f * track.rest.scale.x);
// 실제 키 선택·배율 제한·복원은 아래 standard::Console 소스를 따른다.

시계를 정지해도 seconds는 유지되므로 같은 시각에서 편집 결과를 즉시 볼 수 있다. 입력 후 재생을 재개해도 rest가 남는다. standard의 handleJointKey는 실패 시 rest를 복원하고, R은 선택 관절의 최초 rest를 복원한다.

실제 저장소 소스 · standard/Console.h
#pragma once
#include "framework/Framework.h"

class Console {
    graphics::Application& app_;
    std::optional<graphics::MotionId> pathId_;
    std::optional<graphics::MotionId> spinId_;
    std::optional<graphics::MotionId> globalId_;
    std::optional<graphics::LayerId> mirrorLayer_;
    std::optional<graphics::LayerId> normalSpinLayer_;
    std::optional<graphics::LayerId> insertedLayer_;
    bool paused_ = false;
    bool spinEnabled_ = true;
    bool globalEnabled_ = false;
    int reflection_ = 1;

    enum class Demo { Motion, Grid, Room, Animation };

    Demo demo_ = Demo::Motion;
    graphics::AnimationClock clock_;
    graphics::DistancePath distancePath_;
    std::vector<graphics::EntityId> gridBoxes_;
    graphics::RoomBody roomBody_;
    graphics::EntityId room_ = 0, roomCube_ = 0;
    std::vector<graphics::JointAnimation> animation_;

    struct JointControl {
        std::size_t track = 0;
        std::string name;
        graphics::Transform3D initialRest;
    };

    std::vector<JointControl> jointControls_;
    std::size_t selectedJoint_ = 0;
    int selectedAxis_ = 0;
    /// 선택한 관절의 기준 SRT와 피벗을 키 입력으로 편집한다.
    bool handleJointKey(int key);
    /// 현재 선택 관절과 조작 축을 콘솔에 출력한다.
    void printSelectedJoint() const;

    bool threeViews_ = false, trace_ = false, floorOpen_ = false;
    /// 거리 기반 격자 예제를 구성한다.
    bool initGrid();
    /// 회전하는 방 예제를 구성한다.
    bool initRoom();
    /// 선형보간·그네·사람 관절의 계층 애니메이션 예제를 구성한다.
    bool initAnimation();

    /// 선택한 경로로 이동 모션을 바꾼다.
    bool choosePath(int kind);
    /// 반사 변환을 순서대로 변경한다.
    bool changeReflection();
    /// 크기 레이어를 삽입하거나 제거한다.
    bool toggleInsertedLayer();
    /// 조작 방법을 출력한다.
    void printHelp() const;

public:
    /// 애플리케이션 참조를 보관한다.
    explicit Console(graphics::Application& app) : app_(app) {
    }

    /// 장면 객체와 초기 상태를 구성한다.
    bool initScene();
    /// 키 입력에 따라 동작을 변경한다.
    void onKey(int key, int action);
    /// 마우스 버튼 입력을 처리한다.
    void onMouse(const graphics::MouseEvent& event);
    /// 프레임 시간으로 상태와 장면을 갱신한다.
    void onUpdate(float dt);
    /// 현재 장면을 지정한 뷰로 렌더링한다.
    bool onRender();
};
